AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Animation.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Animation Classes AnimationManager Abstract base class for managing Kerbal character animations, including emotes, fidgets, and eye parameter control. AnimationManager.AnimSetData Serializable data container describing an animation set, including the target animator layer and state name. AnimationManager_EVA Manages animator parameters and state transitions for an EVA kerbal, covering movement, jetpack, ladder, water, emote, and science animations. AnimationManager_Expressions AnimationManager subclass that drives Kerbal character facial expression animator parameters based on flight forces and Kerbal personality attributes. AnimationManager_IVA Manages IVA Kerbal character animations, extending AnimationManager with expression, fidget, sickness, and sleep state control driven by g-force and flight inputs. AnimationManager_SimpleTimewarpSubscriber An AnimationManager that drives animation speed from the current timewarp index on each frame update. CutsceneManager Represents a MonoBehaviour that manages the playback and pausing of a cutscene by controlling child Animator components. KrakenMonumentManager Manages the animated eye behavior of the Kraken monument, directing its gaze at nearby vessels and applying shake proportional to vessel part count. LateUpdateConstraint A base class for late-update transform constraints that can be chained to execute after a specified parent constraint has completed its update. LateUpdateConstraint_AimAt A LateUpdateConstraint that aims a configurable axis of the attached transform at a target transform, using a secondary transform to define the up direction. LateUpdateConstraint_Position A LateUpdateConstraint subclass that constrains the transform's local position to match a target transform's world position. OffsetSliderSystem Manages a collection of named offset sliders and toggles that drive transform position, rotation, scale, and constraint weights on a part. OffsetSliderSystem.DynamicSliderLimit Represents a curve-based dynamic limit applied to a slider's effective range, driven by the value of a named parent slider. OffsetSliderSystem.OffsetSliderData Represents the configuration and runtime state of a single named offset slider, including its targets, dynamic limits, and current value. OffsetSliderSystem.OffsetToggleData Represents the configuration and runtime state of a named boolean toggle, including message publication on state change. OffsetSliderSystem.SliderMeasurement Represents a measurement taken between two transforms, reporting distance or angular offset according to a specified measurement mode. OffsetSliderSystem.SliderTargetData Represents the target transform and value range for one animation axis of an offset slider. PositionGantryByVesselSize Positions the launch gantry along its travel range to match the bounding box extent of the vessel on the pad. RandomAnimationTriggerManager Fires a named Animator trigger at a random interval between a configurable minimum and maximum wait time. SetRandomPosition Randomizes the position of its transform on enable, either by applying a random vector offset within a configurable range or by moving to one of a set of target transforms. SimpleFidgetManager Manages randomized fidget animation cycles for a Kerbal character, driving an Animator with configurable idle animation sets and randomized timing intervals. SkinMeshToStaticGenerator Represents a MonoBehaviour that bakes skinned meshes into static mesh and collision counterparts at runtime. SkinMeshToStaticGenerator.AttachNodeData Represents attach node configuration data, pairing a node name with a target bone transform. SkinMeshToStaticGenerator.StaticSetData Represents a named set of skinned and static meshes to be baked into a static representation. StackObjectsBetweenTwoPoints Represents a MonoBehaviour that instances and arranges stack pieces between two defined transform points. StackObjectsBetweenTwoPoints.StackPieceData Represents the metadata for a single stack piece, including its name, index, and measured length. TranslateBetweenTwoPointsOverTime Represents a KerbalMonoBehaviour that translates its GameObject between a start and end point over a configurable duration, with optional random position offsets at each end. TranslateBetweenTwoPointsOverTime.PointPairData Serializable data defining a start and end Transform pair with optional per-axis random offset maximums. TriggerVFXFromAnimation Triggers a group of ParticleSystem effects on or off when called from animation events. Enums OffsetSliderSystem.OffsetSliderMeasurementMode The axis or measurement type used when sampling a slider's current value. OffsetSliderSystem.OffsetSliderMode The transform property targeted by an offset slider. SkinMeshToStaticGenerator.VectorFlipMode Specifies the axis or axes along which a vector is negated during mesh baking.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.DebugTools.html.title: Namespace KSP.DebugTools | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.DebugTools.html.summary: Namespace KSP.DebugTools Classes BookmarksPanel Represents a UI panel for creating, selecting, and deleting teleport location bookmarks. FXDebugPartItem Represents a UI list item displaying a simulation object in the FX debug tools panel, with controls for damage, activation, and destruction. FXDebugTools Represents a debug window for inspecting and controlling visual effects on simulation parts and vessels. FlightTools Debug window for inspecting simulation objects (vessels, parts, joint connections, and celestial bodies) during flight. FlightToolsItem<T> A base class for flight tools UI items that bind to a model and handle pointer enter and exit events. JointConnectionItem Represents a debug tools list item that displays joint connection data between two parts. JointInspector Represents a debug inspector for monitoring and recording joint forces, torques, and angles between two connected GameObjects. KerbalRosterToolWindow Debug tool window for viewing and managing the Kerbal roster. LogConsoleEntry Represents a single log entry row displayed in the log console window. LogConsoleWindow Debug console window that captures Unity log messages and displays them with per-level filters for info, warning, and error entries. LogEntry Represents a single captured log message with its condition, stack trace, type, and timestamp. LogList Represents a virtualized scrolling list of log entries for the debug console. OABDebugOverlay Represents a debug overlay that displays diagnostic information for Object Assembly Building parts in the scene. OABDebugOverlayManager Manages the OAB debug assembly overlay prefab instance. OABResourceDebugTool Represents a debug tool for inspecting resource data in the Object Assembly Building. PlanetViewerWindow Debug window for teleporting to and observing celestial bodies in the planet viewer, with support for saving and loading bookmarks. PlanetViewerWindow.PlanetViewerBookmark Serializable bookmark storing the celestial body name and camera position for the planet viewer. QuickActionDebugTools API for registering quick-action debug script callbacks that spawn vessels in various game states. RenderingDebugToolWindow Debug tool window for controlling the enabled state of the physics, scaled, and flare render cameras. ScienceExperimentResearchReportToolsWindow Debug window for displaying science experiment definitions and managing test research reports on the active vessel. ScienceToolsWindow Debug window providing controls for science points, tech node data, and the unlock-all-parts cheat. SimObjectItem Represents a debug flight-tools list item that displays and controls a SimulationObjectModel. TeleportBookmarkWalkToolWindow Debug tool window that steps sequentially through a list of teleport bookmarks, optionally auto-saving before each teleport. TeleportBookmarksManager Manages named teleport bookmarks grouped by celestial body, loading and saving them as JSON files on disk. TeleportWindow Debug window for teleporting vessels or parts to orbital, surface, or rendezvous positions. TerrainDebugToolWindow Represents the terrain debug tool window, providing controls for biome visualization, triplanar mapping, and mesh bucketing. ThermalDebugToolWindow Debug tool window that displays per-part thermal data for the active vessel. TriggersToolsJointsWindow Debug window for inspecting vessel joint counts, rigidity settings, physics mode, and extra-joints configuration in the TriggersTools suite. VesselCoordinateLocationWindow Debug window that displays the coordinate location of the active vessel. VesselScienceDebugToolWindow Debug tool window for inspecting the science situation and region data of a vessel, with an optional PQS science region overlay. Structs ClipboardTeleportPosition Represents a serializable teleport position that can be copied to or read from the system clipboard as JSON. TeleportBookmark Defines a teleportation bookmark for the Debug Tools' teleportation window Enums BookmarkType The category of a debug bookmark location. JointInspector.JointDirectionEnum Represents the local-space axis direction used for joint angle measurement. Delegates FillBookmarkState Delegate for populating a TeleportBookmark with state data.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Flow.html.title: Namespace KSP.Game.Flow | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Flow.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Game.Flow Classes FlowAction A base class for a named, timed action within a game flow sequence, executed asynchronously with resolve and reject callbacks. FreezeProceduralPartDefinitionDatabaseFlowAction Flow action that freezes and caches the procedural part definition database, preventing new definitions from being added. FreezeResourceDefinitionDatabaseFlowAction Flow action that freezes the resource definition database, preventing new resource definitions from being added. GenericFlowAction A FlowAction implementation that executes a caller-supplied delegate as the action's work. LoadAssetFlowAction<T> A FlowAction that loads a Unity asset of type T from an AssetProvider using a string key. LoadAssetReferenceFlowAction<T> FlowAction that loads an UnityEngine.AddressableAssets.AssetReferenceT<TObject> using an AssetProvider and delivers the result through a callback. LoadAssetReferencesFlowAction<T> FlowAction that loads a list of Addressable asset references of type T via an AssetProvider. LoadAssetsFlowAction<T> FlowAction that loads a batch of assets of type T from an AssetProvider, invoking a per-asset callback and a completion callback on finish. LoadStartingCelestialBodyFlowAction A FlowAction that loads the starting celestial body's space view during game load, waiting for its local-space or scaled-space representation to finish spawning. PopulateProceduralPartDatabaseFlowAction Flow action that loads procedural part assets and populates the procedural part definition database. PopulateResourceDefinitionDatabaseFlowAction FlowAction that loads resource definition assets and populates the game's resource definition database. ReduxFlowAction Wraps an IFlowAction as a KSP FlowAction, delegating name, description, and execution to the underlying Redux action. SaveGameMetadataLoader Manages a collection of SavedGameMetaDataLoaderInstance instances that load metadata from saved game files. SaveGameThumbnailCreator Creates thumbnail image files for save game entries by asynchronously capturing the screen and encoding the result to disk. SavedGameMetaDataLoaderInstance Represents a single asynchronous instance for loading saved-game metadata from disk, invoking a callback when the load completes or fails. SequentialFlow Represents a sequential execution pipeline that runs a list of FlowAction items one at a time, tracking flow state, progress, and errors. Delegates OnLoadCleanup Handler invoked to perform cleanup after a load operation on a SavedGameMetaDataLoaderInstance.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Missions.Definit.summary: Namespace KSP.Game.Missions.Definitions Classes ActiveMissions Represents the active missions associated with a specific owner. CompletedStages Represents the completed mission stages and current stage progress for a single player. MissionData Represents a mission definition, including its identity, type, state, stages, and branching structure. MissionDataList Represents a serializable list of MissionData definitions. MissionReward Represents the reward associated with a mission, containing a collection of MissionRewardDefinition entries. MissionRewardDefinition Represents a single reward associated with a mission. MissionSaveData Represents the serialized save data for a single mission, including its ID, completed stages, and availability and completion state. MissionStage Represents a single stage within a mission definition, including its actions, branches, conditions, and reward configuration. TrackedMissions Represents the set of tracked missions associated with a specific mission owner. Structs MissionDataStageSave Represents the saved state of a mission stage, including its name, parent mission identifier, and completion status. MissionStateSave Represents the serialized save state of a mission, including its ID, current state, and stage progress. MissionStateSaveList Represents a serializable collection of mission state saves for persisting mission progress. Interfaces IMissionConditionOwner Interface for types that own and manage mission conditions. Enums DialogEntryType The type of content displayed in a mission dialog entry. MissionOwner The owner category of a mission. MissionRewardType The type of reward granted upon completing a mission. MissionType Classification of a mission as primary, secondary, tutorial, or first-time user experience. TextSpeed Speed setting for displaying mission text. UIDisplayType Represents the UI display context in which a mission is presented.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Missions.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Game.Missions Classes ActivateMissionAction Mission action that activates a mission by MissionOwner and target mission ID. CharacterDialogDataContext Represents the API data context for a character dialog, managing a list of CharacterDialogUIEntry dialog entries. CharacterDialogEntry Represents a character dialog entry in a mission, carrying its type, localization key, and content-addressable key. CharacterDialogUIEntry Represents a UI data context for a single character dialog entry in a mission, loading and exposing localized text, image, and video assets for display. CharacterDialogWindow Represents the mission character dialog window, presenting sequential dialog entries with character name, icon, and optional auto-continue. Condition A base class for mission conditions, providing virtual evaluation and lifecycle methods used by concrete condition implementations. ConditionSet A composite Condition that evaluates a collection of child conditions combined by a LogicalOperator. DialogEntries Represents a serializable collection of CharacterDialogEntry objects for a mission dialog. EventCondition Condition that evaluates to true when a specified game message event type has been observed. FullscreenVideoAction Mission action that displays a fullscreen tutorial video when activated. Highlight_AttachNode Represents a highlight effect positioned at a named attach node on a part. KSP2MissionLuaInterface Represents the Lua scripting interface for KSP2 missions, exposing mission activation and state-management callbacks to the game script environment. KSP2MissionManager Manages the KSP2 mission and tutorial lifecycle, tracking active, completed, and pending missions throughout the game session. MessageBoxAction Mission action that displays a tutorial message box with configurable title, message, button type, image, and on-screen positioning. MissionActionBase A base class for mission actions, providing stage event activation and deep-copy support. MissionActionOABSettings Mission action that applies OAB configuration on activation, including workspace loading, favorite parts, part category, and optional vessel backup restoration. MissionAudioAction Represents a mission action that plays audio when the mission stage is activated. MissionBranch Represents a conditional branch in a mission that evaluates a Condition and transitions to a target stage when the condition is met. MissionCharacterDialogAction Represents a mission action that shows a character dialog window with localized character details and sequential dialog entries. MissionContentBranch Represents a named branch of mission actions that can be activated or deactivated on demand by branch ID. MissionCreateSnapshotAction Represents a mission action that creates a reload snapshot at the current mission stage. MissionDestinationPosition Mission action that sets a celestial body destination position using surface coordinates and creates a waypoint on activation. MissionDisableInputAction Mission action that disables user input controls of the specified MissionDisableInputTypes type when activated. MissionHighlightAction Mission action that activates a configurable visual highlight, targeting a sim object, OAB part, celestial body, or orbit node. MissionIndicatorAction Mission action that displays a custom UI indicator, optionally anchored to a normalized screen position or tracking a 3D object in the scene. MissionLogicUtil Provides utility methods for mission logic. MissionMagicValues Shared state fields and constants used across the mission system. MissionPauseAction Represents a mission action that pauses the game and stops time warp when activated. MissionReloadSnapshotAction Mission action that reloads the last saved snapshot of the parent mission when activated. MissionResolutionAction Mission action that sets the resolution state of its parent mission, optionally deferring the state change until the mission summary screen is dismissed. MissionScriptAction Mission action that executes a Lua script via the game script environment when activated. MissionSetViewStateAction Mission action that sets the UI view state by pushing a configured UIView to the view controller. MissionSlideshowAction Mission indicator action that spawns a Slideshow window and loads the configured slides into it. MissionTriumphWindow Represents the mission triumph window displayed on mission completion, showing congratulatory text, science reward totals, objectives, and an optional triumph video. MissionUIElement Represents a single mission entry in the Mission Control UI as a bindable data context, exposing properties for the mission title, description, type, and state. PartSizeHighlightScale Represents a mapping from a part size filter type to a highlight scale value. PropertyCondition Condition that tests a PropertyWatcher value against a threshold using a PropertyOperator comparison. SaveLoadMissionUtils Utility methods for saving and loading mission data. ScriptCondition Condition that evaluates success by subscribing to a configurable message event type and delegating evaluation to a ScriptMethodReference script. WorkspaceSelectionData Represents the selection state for a workspace entry in the missions UI, including addressable and thumbnail keys and button selection flags. Enums ConditionTypes The kind of condition used in a mission. LogicalOperator Logical operator used to combine mission conditions. MissionDisableInputTypes Input scope categories that a mission can disable. PropertyOperator Comparison operator for evaluating a mission property value against a target condition.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.Science.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Game.Science Classes CBSituationData Represents altitude boundaries and science scalar multipliers for the science situations of a celestial body. CelestialBodyBakedDiscoverables Represents the baked set of discoverable positions associated with a named celestial body. CelestialBodyBakedScienceRegionMap Represents a precomputed science region map for a celestial body, stored as a binary-serialized Unity asset. CelestialBodyDiscoverablePosition Represents a discoverable position on a celestial body, defined by a science region, a spatial location, and a detection radius. CelestialBodyScienceRegionsData Represents the science regions data for a celestial body, including situation data and region definitions. ExperimentCore Represents the serializable core data for a science experiment, including a version stamp and an ExperimentDefinition. ExperimentDefinition Represents the definition of a science experiment, including its valid research locations, type, and associated data and sample values. FlavorDescription Represents a flavor text description associated with a specific science research location. PQSScienceOverlay Represents a PQS terrain overlay that renders science-region data as a colored texture on a celestial body's surface. RDCenterUIController UI controller for the Research and Development Center, managing the tech tree display, tech node selection, and science point spending. ResearchLocation Represents a science research location defined by a celestial body, science situation, and optional science region. ResearchReport Represents a completed science experiment report, including its location, type, science value, and transmission state. ScienceDataStore A base class for science data storage, providing initialization and disposal lifecycle. ScienceExperimentsDataStore A ScienceDataStore implementation that loads and stores science experiment definitions from labeled assets. ScienceMPActionData Represents the data payload for a multiplayer science action, including the target route, action type, and optional string parameter. ScienceManager Manages the science subsystem, including tech node unlocking, research report submission, science point tracking, and experiment data. ScienceRegionDefinition Represents a science region definition, specifying situation scalars for atmosphere, splashed, and landed states. ScienceRegionsDataProvider Provides science region data for celestial bodies, including region definitions, baked region maps, and discoverables. ScienceRegionsHelper Static utility class providing constants and helpers for science region addressable labels and localized display names. TechNodeData Represents the serialized data for a single tech tree node, including its display info, science point cost, unlock requirements, and position. TechNodeDataStore Stores tech node definitions loaded from labeled assets, providing indexed access to TechNodeData entries and part-ID unlock lookups. TechNodeInfoPartContext Data context for a part entry in the tech tree node info panel, exposing part icon, identifier, size color, and size text properties. TechNodeTweakable Represents a tweakable tech tree node ScriptableObject asset that wraps a TechNodeData definition. TechNodeView Represents a UI view for a single technology tree node, managing its display state and tooltip interaction. TechRequiredResearchData Represents research conditions required to unlock a technology node, including experiment, location, and report type. Structs CompletedResearchReport Represents a completed science research report, capturing the experiment ID, research location, report type, final science value, and recovery state. ScienceLocationRegionSituation Represents a science research location paired with its celestial body, region, and situation scalar values. Enums ResearchReportFilterType Filter categories for classifying research reports by celestial body, situation, experiment, or report type. ScienceActionGroupState Flags enumeration representing the available and in-progress states of science action groups. ScienceExperimentType The type of result produced by a science experiment. ScienceMPAction Actions available in a science multiplayer session. ScienceReportType Kinds of science report, distinguishing digital data from physical samples. ScienceSitutation Science situations that classify a vessel's current orbital or surface environment for science collection. TechNodeView.NodeState The visibility and unlock state of a technology tree node.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.html.title: Namespace KSP.Game | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Game.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Game Classes ActionGroupActionElement Represents a single action available for action group mapping, wrapping a ModuleActionGroupAction with bindable display and mapping state properties. ActionGroupElement Represents a single action group entry in the game UI, providing data-bound properties and actions for a KSPActionGroup. ActionGroupManager Pop-up UI manager for assigning and managing action groups for vessel parts in flight and Object Assembly Building contexts. AgencyColorPicker Represents a UI color picker for selecting agency base and accent colors in HSV color space. AgencyEntry Represents a single in-game agency, holding its identity, appearance, science-point data, missions, and resource scan history. AgencyFlag Represents an agency flag, including its name, icon sprite, and primary and secondary colors. AgencyFlagItem Represents a selectable agency flag entry in the new campaign UI, binding flag name and icon to a toggle element via a data context. AgencyFlagManager Manages agency flag and color selection for the campaign creation screen, populating available flags from built-in and custom sources and tracking the selected flag icon and agency colors. AgencyMPActionData Represents multiplayer action data for an agency, including identity, action state, and associated science and mission details. AgencyManager Manages the collection of agencies within a game instance, providing registration, lookup, and lifecycle control for AgencyEntry objects. AgencyUtils Static utility class providing constants and helpers for agency configuration. AgencyUtils.TeamColorSet Represents a base and accent color pair for an agency team. AnalyticsUtils Static utility class for sending game analytics and telemetry events. AuxiliarySceneUtilities Utility methods for moving GameObjects between Unity scenes and restoring their original parent transforms. BreadcrumbsController Manages the breadcrumbs navigation UI, updating the displayed trail in response to game state and vessel changes. CampaignLoadMenu Represents the campaign load menu, managing save file entries and handling load, delete, and campaign metadata display. CampaignMenu Manages the campaign selection menu, displaying available save files and handling create, load, sort, and delete operations. CampaignPlayerEntry Represents the state and settings for a single player within a campaign, including identity, game state, active vessel, and progression data. CampaignPlayerMPActionData Represents the multiplayer action data for a campaign player, capturing identity, game state, vessel context, and synchronized field values. CampaignPlayerManager Manages the collection of campaign players and provides lookups by name, GUID, and player ID. CampaignPlayerUtil Utility methods for serializing and deserializing a campaign player's favorited parts dictionary. CampaignTileEntry Represents a single campaign tile in the campaign selection menu, binding save file data to the tile's display properties and handling tile selection. CelestialBodyAssetLoader Manages loading and unloading of local-space and scaled-space views for CelestialBodyComponent instances. CelestialBodyProvider Manages and provides access to the game's celestial body registries, including lighting, lens flares, post-processing, and ring group data. CelestialDataProvider Provides data-bound property access for a CelestialBodyComponent, exposing position, radius, atmosphere, and orbital relationship properties. CheatsMenu Represents the in-game cheats menu, providing controls for teleportation, orbital parameter overrides, and other debug state modifications. ClimbBehavior SpatialBehavior that manages a collection of ClimbInstance objects for a climbable surface, registering them with the climb system and loading their presets asynchronously. ClimbInstance Represents a climb spatial instance that holds a ClimbPresetAssetReference and initiates climbing via ClimbBehavior. ClimbPreset Represents a serializable ScriptableObject asset defining the climb flags and type for a climb preset. ClimbPresetAssetReference Represents a typed Addressable asset reference for ClimbPreset. ClimbSystem Spatial registry system for tracking ClimbInstance objects and querying neighboring instances within a given range. CommNetManager Manages the communications network connection graph, registering nodes and periodically rebuilding paths from the designated control-source node. CompareDateTime Compares two ExtendedSaveFileInfo instances by last-write time, ordering them newest first. CreateCampaignMenu Represents the create-campaign menu, managing the UI flow through sub-menus for game mode, difficulty, campaign name, agency name, and flag and color selection. DataBus<T> A base class for data binding objects that hold a typed data source and a DataContext. DeltaVToolManagerUI Pop-up UI manager for the Delta-V tool, displaying per-stage delta-V data with celestial body and altitude selection. DifficultyOptionStates A dictionary mapping difficulty option names to their current state values. DifficultyOptionsDataManager Manages difficulty option presets and their current state for a game session. DifficultyOptionsMenu Represents the difficulty options menu used when creating a new campaign, managing preset difficulty level selection and dynamically populated option toggles and sliders. DifficultyOptionsUtils Utility class providing constant keys and default values for difficulty option settings. EmptyOnPurpose Represents an intentionally empty placeholder value. ExceptionTracker Tracks runtime exceptions and displays the accumulated exception count on the game HUD. ExtendedSaveFileInfo Represents a save file entry combining a SaveFileInfo with its associated SerializedSaveGameMetadata. FlagObject Represents a plantable flag object with a cloth renderer and animation configuration for the flag-planting sequence. GameInstance Represents the central game instance, owning and coordinating all major game systems including sessions, UI, audio, scripting, and update loops. GameManager Represents the top-level singleton MonoBehaviour that orchestrates the game's startup and shutdown flow, scene transitions, and access to core subsystems. GameModeButtonContext Represents the data context for a game mode selection button, holding its display properties and the action to activate the mode. GameModeManager Manages the active game mode, loading available modes from labeled assets and providing feature and difficulty option queries for the current selection. GameModePicker Represents a UI component that presents the available game modes as selectable toggle buttons during campaign creation. GameModeUtils Utility constants for game mode identifiers and feature flag keys. GameStateConfiguration Represents the configuration of the current game state, including mode flags for object assembly, flight, and session status. Declaration public InputBinding? bindingMask { get; set; } Property Value Type Description InputBinding? Optional mask that determines which bindings in the asset to enable. Remarks Binding masks can be applied at three different levels: for an entire asset through this property, for a specific map through UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.bindingMask, and for single actions through UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.bindingMask. By default, none of the masks will be set (i.e. they will be null). When an action is enabled, all the binding masks that apply to it are taken into account. Specifically, this means that any given binding on the action will be enabled only if it matches the mask applied to the asset, the mask applied to the map that contains the action, and the mask applied to the action itself. All the masks are individually optional. Masks are matched against bindings using UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputBinding.Matches(UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputBinding). Note that if you modify the masks applicable to an action while it is enabled, the action's UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.controls will get updated immediately to respect the mask. To avoid repeated binding resolution, it is most efficient to apply binding masks before enabling actions. Binding masks are non-destructive. All the bindings on the action are left in place. Setting a mask will not affect the value of the UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.bindings and UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.bindings properties. See Also MaskByGroup(string) bindingMask bindingMask bindings Iterate over all bindings in the asset. Declaration public IEnumerable<InputBinding> bindings { get; } Property Value Type Description IEnumerable<InputBinding> Remarks This iterates over all action maps in UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionAsset.actionMaps and, within each map, over the set of UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.bindings. See Also bindings controlSchemes List of control schemes defined in the asset. Declaration public ReadOnlyArray<InputControlScheme> controlSchemes { get; } Property Value Type Description ReadOnlyArray<InputControlScheme> Control schemes defined for the asset. See Also AddControlScheme(InputActionAsset, string) RemoveControlScheme(InputActionAsset, string) devices Set of devices that bindings in the asset can bind to. Declaration public ReadOnlyArray<InputDevice>? devices { get; set; } Property Value Type Description ReadOnlyArray<InputDevice>? Optional set of devices to use by bindings in the asset. Remarks By default (with this property being null), bindings will bind to any of the controls available through UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputSystem.devices, i.e. controls from all devices in the system will be used. By setting this property, binding resolution can instead be restricted to just specific devices. This restriction can either be applied to an entire asset using this property or to specific action maps by using UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.devices. Note that if both this property and UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionMap.devices is set for a specific action map, the list of devices on the action map will take precedence and the list on the asset will be ignored for bindings in that action map. // Create an asset with a single action map and a single action with a // gamepad binding. var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<InputActionAsset>(); var actionMap = new InputActionMap(); var fireAction = actionMap.AddAction("Fire", binding: "<Gamepad>/buttonSouth"); asset.AddActionMap(actionMap); // Let's assume we have two gamepads connected. If we enable the // action map now, the 'Fire' action will bind to both. actionMap.Enable(); // This will print two controls. Debug.Log(string.Join("\n", fireAction.controls)); // To restrict the setup to just the first gamepad, we can assign // to the 'devices' property (in this case, we could do so on either // the action map or on the asset; we choose the latter here). asset.devices = new InputDevice[] { Gamepad.all[0] }; // Now this will print only one control. Debug.Log(string.Join("\n", fireAction.controls)); See Also devices Methods Contains(InputAction) Return true if the given action is part of the asset. Declaration public InputAction FindAction(string actionNameOrId, bool throwIfNotFound = false) Parameters Type Name Description string actionNameOrId Name of the action as either a "map/action" combination (e.g. "gameplay/fire") or a simple name (e.g. "fire"). In the former case, the name is split at the '/' slash and the first part is used to find a map with that name and the second part is used to find an action with that name inside the map. In the latter case, all maps are searched in order and the first action that has the given name in any of the maps is returned. Note that name comparisons are case-insensitive. Alternatively, the given string can be a GUID as given by <xref href="UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputAction.id" data-throw-if-not-resolved="false"></xref>. bool throwIfNotFound If true, instead of returning null when the action cannot be found, throw ArgumentException. Remarks Note that no lookup structures are used internally to speed the operation up. Instead, the search is done linearly. For repeated access of an action, it is thus generally best to look up actions once ahead of time and cache the result. If multiple actions have the same name and actionNameOrId is not an ID and not an action name qualified by a map name (that is, in the form of "mapName/actionName"), the action that is returned will be from the first map in UnityEngine.InputSystem.InputActionAsset.actionMaps that has an action with the given name. An exception is if, of the multiple actions with the same name, some are enabled and some are disabled. In this case, the first action that is enabled is returned. If an action name contains a slash "/", e.g. "yaw/pitch" and there is also a map called "yaw" which contains an action "pitch", the action "pitch" within the map "yaw" will be returned instead of the action named "yaw/pitch". var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<InputActionAsset>(); var map1 = new InputActionMap("map1"); var map2 = new InputActionMap("map2"); asset.AddActionMap(map1); asset.AddActionMap(map2); var action1 = map1.AddAction("action1"); var action2 = map1.AddAction("action2"); var action3 = map2.AddAction("action3"); // Search all maps in the asset for any action that has the given name. asset.FindAction("action1") // Returns action1. asset.FindAction("action2") // Returns action2 asset.FindAction("action3") // Returns action3. // Search for a specific action in a specific map. asset.FindAction("map1/action1") // Returns action1. asset.FindAction("map2/action2") // Returns action2. asset.FindAction("map3/action3") // Returns action3. // Search by unique action ID. asset.FindAction(action1.id.ToString()) // Returns action1. asset.FindAction(action2.id.ToString()) // Returns action2. asset.FindAction(action3.id.ToString()) // Returns action3. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Iteration.UI.Binding..title: Namespace KSP.Iteration.UI.Binding | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Iteration.UI.Binding..summary: Namespace KSP.Iteration.UI.Binding Classes ContextNestedHierarchyExample Represents an example MonoBehaviour that demonstrates binding a nested parent-child context hierarchy to a UI bind root. ContextNestedHierarchyExample.ObjectData Represents a node in a data-driven context hierarchy, exposing name, parent reference, and children as bindable properties. FlightDataUIExample_FlightHud Represents a flight HUD MonoBehaviour example that binds incoming data context to a locator for display. FlightDataUIExample_Locator Represents a MonoBehaviour that instantiates a flight data UI prefab and binds it to a data context. FlightDataUIExample_ViewController Example view controller that initializes a VesselApi data context and passes it to a FlightDataUIExample_FlightHud. Part Represents a UI binding data context for a part, exposing its name and on/off state. UIDataDemoVesselBinder A base class for UI data binders that bind to an IDemoVessel, providing canvas group visibility management tied to the bound state. UIData_DemoEntity UIDataBinder that binds the GUID text, name field, and score display elements to an IDemoEntity data source. UIData_DemoHealth UIDataBinder for the demo health UI, binding an IDemoHealth data source to health display elements and revive, kill, hurt, and heal action buttons. UIData_DemoVessel A UIDataDemoVesselBinder implementation that binds map-toggle, GUID, altitude, and velocity UI elements to a demo vessel and animates visibility with DOTween fades and position offsets. UIValue_ReadIsDead_Icon UI value binder that reads a dead/alive boolean and reflects it as a color-coded icon. VesselApi Represents a UI data binding context exposing vessel part data. Structs ContextNestedHierarchyExample.ObjectInput Represents the inspector-editable definition of a named object and its optional parent within the hierarchy.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Map.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Map Classes GalaxyCubeRenderShim A shim component that adapts galaxy cube camera rendering to the ICameraRenderView interface. GizmoData Represents a pairing of a ManeuverNodeData with its corresponding MapManeuverGizmo. GizmoTest Test scene controller that positions and exercises a MapManeuverGizmo within a fly-camera environment. InfoPanelCrewMember Represents a crew member entry in a map info panel, displaying the member's name and portrait icon. InfoPanelDeliveryResource Represents a map info panel row that displays a delivery resource name and its quantity in kilograms. Line3DIntersect Represents a debug component that casts a camera ray against a 3D polyline, finds the closest segment point, and renders the intersection in the map view. Map3DCameraCulling Represents a component that raises a visibility-changed event when the attached renderer enters or leaves the camera's view. Map3DFocusItem Represents a selectable item in the 3D map view, managing its icon, sphere-of-influence visual, and context-panel target state. Map3DFocusItemIcon Represents the sprite icon rendered in the 3D map view for a Map3DFocusItem, handling billboard rotation, scale, and occlusion sorting against the parent celestial body. Map3DFocusItemIcon.IconForType Serializable mapping of a MapItemType to a corresponding icon sprite. Map3DFocusItemInteractable Interactable component attached to a Map3DFocusItem that manages hover highlighting, tooltip display, and click-driven selection and camera focus in the 3D map view. Map3DFocusItemInteractableProxy Proxy component for interactable 3D map focus items that handles pointer hover events by toggling the attached renderer's material color. Map3DManeuvers Manages maneuver node gizmos and orbit interaction in the 3D map view. Map3DOrbitalMarker Represents a UI marker displayed on the 3D orbital map for an orbital item such as a vessel, celestial body, or orbital event. Map3DPopup Popup UI element in the 3D map view that tracks a MapItem and displays its name, icon, and contextual detail lines. Map3DPopup.IconPair Associates a MapItemType value with its corresponding icon sprite. Map3DSpaceProvider Represents the spatial coordinate provider for the 3D map view, managing scale factors and transform updates for registered map items. Map3DSpaceProviderTarget Represents a target in the 3D map space that configures position, rotation, and scale adjustments for the associated model. Map3DTooltips Manages a pooled collection of Map3DPopup tooltips that follow UnityEngine.GameObject targets on the 3D map camera. Map3DTrajectoryEvents Manages trajectory event markers on the 3D map view. Map3DView Represents the 3D map view, managing camera control, focus items, orbit rendering, tooltips, and maneuver overlays for the map scene. MapCamera Camera behaviour for the map view, extending KerbalCameraBehaviour with orbital controls, pivot management, and gimbal state via ICameraGimbalStateProvider. MapCameraInputHandler Handles player input for the map view camera, translating mouse and keyboard actions into rotation, pan, and zoom operations on a MapCamera. MapCameraTweakables Represents tweakable camera parameters specific to the map view, extending CameraTweakables with zoom responsiveness, drag, and translation settings. MapCore Core controller for the KSP map view, managing map items, focus state, and coordinating the MapUI and Map3DView components. MapItem Represents a trackable item on the map, such as a vessel, celestial body, or waypoint. MapLog Logging utility for the KSP map system. MapLookAtCamera Rotates the attached transform each frame to face a target camera, keeping billboard elements oriented toward the viewer in the map view. MapMagicValues API for map view constants and orbit renderer configuration values. MapManeuverGizmo Represents the interactive gizmo for a maneuver node in the map view, managing collapsed and expanded visual states and handling user input for burn adjustments. MapManeuverGizmo2DCollapsed Represents the collapsed view of the 2D map maneuver node gizmo, managing idle and menu canvas groups. MapManeuverGizmo3DExpanded Represents the expanded 3D maneuver gizmo displayed in map view, providing directional drag handles for prograde, retrograde, normal, anti-normal, radial-in, and radial-out directions. MapManeuverGizmoScaling Scales a map maneuver node gizmo each frame to maintain a constant apparent size relative to a given camera. MapManeuverInputTarget Represents an interactive input target for a map-view maneuver node, handling cursor hover highlighting and dispatching bound UI actions by interaction type. MapManeuverManipulator Represents a draggable handle on the map-view maneuver gizmo, managing hover highlight state for the associated mesh renderers. MapPlanetarium Represents the planetarium display component in the map scene. MapUI Manages the map view UI, including object-type and celestial-body entry lists, info panel, and selection state. MapUISelectableEntry Represents a selectable entry in the map UI, displaying information and action controls for a map item such as a vessel or celestial body. MapUISelectableEntryEvents Represents a MonoBehaviour component that handles pointer enter and exit events for a MapUISelectableEntry, toggling its action button visibility. OrbitRenderSegment Represents a single renderable segment of an orbital path. OrbitRenderer Renders orbital trajectories and maneuver patches on the KSP map view, managing per-orbit and per-camera rendering state. OrbitRenderer.CameraRenderInstance Represents the per-camera rendering state for orbital trajectories, tracking render data and active render operations for a single camera. OrbitRenderer.CameraRenderInstance.RenderData Represents the rendering state for a single orbit segment within a OrbitRenderer.CameraRenderInstance, holding parametric line generators and polyline paths. OrbitRenderer.OrbitRenderData Represents the rendering data for a single orbital trajectory, including its segment list, color, and thickness settings. OrbitRendererConfiguration ScriptableObject configuration for the orbit renderer, defining subdivision heuristics, line rendering options, and color and thickness settings for each orbit type. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Messages.html.title: Namespace KSP.Messages | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Messages.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Messages Classes AblatorAvailableMessage Represents a message indicating that a vessel's heat shield has ablator remaining. AbortTutorial Represents the message sent when the player aborts the current tutorial. ActionBlockedByTimeWarpMessage Represents a message sent when an action is blocked by time warp. ActionBlockedByTimeWarpPausedMessage Represents a message sent when an action is blocked because time warp is paused. ActionGroupCreatedMessage Message published when the player creates an action group in the object assembly building. ActionGroupManagerOpenedMessage Represents a message sent when the Action Group Manager is opened. ActionGroupMappingChanged Represents a message sent when an action group mapping changes. ActiveManeuverNodeReachedMessage Represents a message fired when the time to reach the active maneuver node is zero. ActiveVesselDestroyedMessage Represents a message published when the active vessel is destroyed. AddVesselToMapMessage Represents a message requesting that a vessel be added to the map view. AssemblyActionGroupsChanged Represents a message sent when the action groups of an ObjectAssembly change. AssemblyMassChangedMessage Message sent when the mass of an object assembly changes. AudioCueMessage A base class for audio cue event messages. AuthenticationMessageBase A base class for authentication-related messages. AutoModeCameraContextMessage Represents the camera context used when the camera is placed in auto mode. BackToKSCMessage Message broadcast when players return to the Kerbal Space Center. BlueprintModeEnabledMessage Represents the message fired when blueprint mode is enabled by clicking on the view cube in the OAB. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.ModularCamera.html.title: Namespace KSP.ModularCamera | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.ModularCamera.html.summary: Namespace KSP.ModularCamera Classes CameraDriverBase A base class for modular camera drivers, providing pivot and gimbal transform management, input interpretation, and validation. DebugDrawHelpers Provides static utility methods for drawing Unity Gizmos debug visualizations for the modular camera system. GlobalInputInterpreters Provides standard input interpreter methods that apply camera movement, zoom, and rotation input to an ICameraDriver in various coordinate spaces. GlobalInputModifiers Provides factory methods for creating standard CameraInputModifier delegates that scale camera input by constant values or distance ratios. GlobalValidators Provides global Validator factory methods for common modular camera constraints, including distance limits and collision-based movement. Structs CameraInputValueList Represents a list of camera input values backed by a double array, with conversion support for common numeric and vector types. Interfaces ICameraDriver Interface for a writable camera driver that controls orientation, position, input interpreters, input modifiers, and validators. ICameraDriverReadOnly Interface for read-only access to a camera driver's transform, orientation, and input-binding state. ICameraInputProvider Interface for reading and forwarding camera input (movement, drag, scroll, and mouse locks) to an ICameraDriver. Enums CameraInputBinding The type of input binding assigned to a modular camera input action. ValidatorType Represents the phase or event that triggers validation in the modular camera system. Delegates CameraInputInterpreter Callback for interpreting camera input values for a given driver and binding configuration. CameraInputModifier Delegate for a callback that modifies camera input values for a given driver and binding. Validator Callback that validates an ICameraDriver against a specified ValidatorType.

DemoLogic_02InputModifiers Sample MonoBehaviour demonstrating multiple input modifier strategies applied to a modular camera driver. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Navigation.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Navigation Classes ADynamicNavLayout Abstract base class for a dynamic navigation layout that manages selectable element groups, focus state, load lifecycle, and cursor synchronization. CanvasNavLayout A ADynamicNavLayout that drives navigation from a Unity Canvas and implements INavElementRegister to support layout tagging. DraggableTag Represents a draggable navigation tag that activates the mouse cursor when a drag operation begins. DropdownLayout Represents a navigation layout for a TMPro.TMP_Dropdown, managing its expanded items within the KSP UI navigation system. DynamicGroup A HierachyGroup that caches accessible SelectableElementInfo entries using a dirty flag, refreshing the lists lazily when elements are added, removed, or changed. DynamicGroupExtension Extension methods for attaching and retrieving a DynamicGroup(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorator on NavElementGroup instances. GamepadClickLayoutTrigger MonoBehaviour that loads the target INavigatable layout via Navigator when a gamepad submit pointer click is received. HierachyGroup Decorator for a NavElementGroup that organizes navigation element groups into a parent-child hierarchy. HierachyGroupExtension Extension methods for attaching and managing HierachyGroup(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorators on NavElementGroup instances. MainCameraElementTag Component tag that registers a UI UnityEngine.UI.Selectable with an IMainCameraSelectableRegister navigation layout on start, retrying until the element is accepted or the timeout elapses. MainCameraNavLayout Dynamic navigation layout bound to the main camera, implementing selectable and navigation element registration for the main camera viewport. NavElementGroup Represents a group of navigable UI UnityEngine.UI.Selectable elements with a typed extension point. NavElementTag Registers a UnityEngine.UI.Selectable with the navigator group and attaches supplementary navigation components for slider and dropdown elements. NavigationExtension Extension methods for UI navigation, providing array containment, float clamping, and direction-based selectable element resolution. NavigationTags Tag string constants identifying UI navigation layouts and screens. Navigator Represents the global UI navigation controller, managing a stack of INavigatable layouts and routing gamepad input actions to the active layout. NavigatorExtensiion Extension methods for cycling an integer index or enum value forward and backward with wrap-around. QuickNavAccessTag Component that registers a UI element as a quick-navigation access point in a named layout, adding the entry on Start and removing it on destroy. QuickNavigationLayout Navigation layout that maintains per-direction lists of QuickNavigationLayout.QuickAccess entries and routes directional input to the nearest selectable UI element. Scrollable Decorator for a NavElementGroup that manages scroll state, boundary tracking, and animated scrolling to selectable elements. ScrollableElementGroup A NavElementGroup that adds automatic scrolling behavior to its navigable elements. ScrollableExtension Extension methods for adding or retrieving a Scrollable(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorator on a NavElementGroup. ScrolledDynamicGroup A DynamicGroup that restricts accessible navigation elements to those visible within a scroll rect boundary. ScrolledDynamicGroupExtension Extension methods for attaching and retrieving the ScrolledDynamicGroup(Extend<NavElementGroup>) decorator on NavElementGroup targets. SliderTag Represents a navigation tag component that enables gamepad control of an attached UnityEngine.UI.Slider, handling focus management, incremental value adjustment, submission, and cancellation. StagingPanelNavElementTag Represents a tag component that registers a staging panel UnityEngine.UI.Selectable with the active navigation layout hierarchy on startup. StagingPanelQuickNavAccessTag Registers a UI element as a quick navigation access point in the staging panel's navigation layout, using either a selectable component or a RectTransform range. Structs ElementInfoMatch Represents the scoring state and best-candidate result for a directional UI navigation match. NavigationParameter Represents the tunable parameters that control navigation target selection behavior. QuickNavigationLayout.QuickAccess Represents a quick-access entry associating a directional selection origin with a target layout and selectable element. SelectableElementInfo Represents a selectable UI or world element within a navigation group, providing screen-space position and size data. Interfaces ICameraProvider Interface for objects that provide a Camera. IHierachyGroupsLayout Interface for a navigation layout that organizes items into hierarchy groups. IMainCameraSelectableRegister Interface for registering and unregistering UI selectables with the main camera's navigation system. INavElementRegister Interface for navigation elements that can be registered with a layout tag. INavigatable Interface for UI panels that support directional keyboard and controller navigation between selectable elements. INavigationLayout Interface for a navigation layout that exposes its Unity transform. INavigator Interface for a navigator that loads, unloads, and tracks navigatable layouts and manages UI input state. IQuickNavRegister Interface for registering quick-navigation access points in specific move directions. IScrollable Interface for objects that can receive and handle scroll input. ISyncCursorPosition Interface for synchronizing the cursor position. Enums LoadType The condition that determines when a navigation element is loaded. Navigator.InputType Input action categories that can be individually enabled or disabled on the navigator. SelectPoint Cardinal directions for selecting a navigation point. SelectionPriorityMode The priority strategy applied when determining which navigation target to select.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Networking.MP.Utils.h.summary: Namespace KSP.Networking.MP.Utils Classes AppInstanceTracker Tracks concurrent application instances by acquiring named system semaphores and assigning each instance a unique number. Bootstrap Manages paired create and destroy lifecycle callbacks for multiplayer network bootstrap initialization. Buffer Represents a byte buffer for reading and writing binary network data. BufferCache Represents a thread-safe singleton that manages named pools of reusable Buffer instances. BufferCachePool Represents a named pool of Buffer objects within a BufferCache, tracking which buffers are in use and which are free. BufferCacheReport Represents a snapshot report of buffer cache statistics, including pool counts, buffer counts, and byte totals. BufferCacheReportEntry Represents a single entry in a buffer cache report, capturing pool name, buffer counts, and byte usage totals. BufferUtil Utility providing size constants, value-range constants, and conversion methods for primitive types and strings in multiplayer networking buffers. ConvertUtil Utility class providing static methods for converting common value types to and from their string representations. Crc Computes CRC-32 checksums over byte arrays and strings using a configurable reverse polynomial lookup table. ErrorFlag Represents a trackable error state that stores whether an error is set, its message, and whether errors should be treated as warnings. FileUtil Static utility class for file I/O operations used by the multiplayer networking layer, including log and persistent data file management. GuidUtil Utility methods for generating and encoding System.Guid values for multiplayer networking. JsonUtil Provides utility methods for serializing and deserializing objects to and from JSON strings. MPConverter Provides conversion methods between primitive types and string representations for multiplayer networking. MPGUIDGenerator Manages a multiplayer GUID paired with an MPRandom state, providing deterministic GUID advancement and configure-string serialization. MPRandom Represents a deterministic pseudo-random number generator for multiplayer synchronization, driven by a seed, bias, and counter. MathUtil Provides math utility methods and constants for multiplayer networking. ModelPosInfo.TOKEN String token constants used as keys and separators in the ModelPosInfo location string encoding. ModelPosUtil Utility methods for reading and applying simulation object position data for multiplayer networking. Pool<T> Represents a generic object pool that manages a collection of reusable instances of T. SectionTimer A start/stop timer that measures elapsed time in milliseconds for a code section. SimUtil Utility methods and types for managing simulation objects in multiplayer networking. SpriteLoader Loads a Sprite asynchronously from an Addressables address, tracking load state and invoking a completion callback on finish. StringBuilderCache A named cache of StringBuilder instances for multiplayer networking utilities, derived from StringBuilderPool. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Rendering.Planets.htm.summary: Namespace KSP.Rendering.Planets Classes AddLandBasedUnderWaterEffect Represents a component that applies the land-based underwater visual effect within a box-collider-defined region, including caustics, water depth, and back-surface rendering driven by camera submersion detection. AtmosphereScatterManager Manages atmosphere scattering model loading and post-process rendering for planets in flight and map views. BiomeLookupHashTable Represents a spatial hash table used to look up biome surface data by UV coordinate on a planetary surface. BiomePhysicsMapping Represents a mapping between KSP2 biome types and their associated Unity physics materials. BiomePhysicsPair Represents a pairing of a KSP2 biome type and an associated physics material. ClearWaterDepthAction Represents a late-update action that clears the water depth buffer by invoking a configurable callback, implementing ILateUpdate and IPriorityOverride. DrawLandBasedWaterAction Represents a late-update action that triggers land-based water rendering during the planetary rendering pipeline. DrawOceanAction Represents a late-update handler that triggers ocean rendering by invoking a registered callback each frame. OceanQuadMeshGenerator Generates quad mesh geometry for planetary ocean surfaces. OceanUpdateAction Late-update action that fires a registered callback to trigger ocean rendering updates. PQData Represents the runtime data for a planet quad-sphere, including subdivision thresholds, tessellation parameters, and native quad collections. PQJob Static container for planetary quad subdivision job types and utility structs used in planet surface rendering. PQS Represents a Procedural Quad Sphere (PQS) planet-terrain component, managing quad subdivision, physics generation, and rendering for a celestial body. PQS.StatCollection Represents a collection of PQS.Stats tracking frame-level, average, and peak quad statistics for a PQS sphere. PQS.Stats Represents quad statistics for a PQS sphere over a single frame or reporting period. PQSCollider Represents a mesh collider instance for a single PQS terrain quad. PQSColliderPool Manages a pool of PQSCollider instances for planet quad-surface mesh collision. PQSColliderRequest Represents a pending async GPU readback request for PQS collider vertex data, holding the associated compute buffer and native arrays for a terrain quad batch. PQSData Represents a planet's PQS (Procedural Quad Sphere) rendering data asset, including height maps, materials, and biome configuration. PQSData.BiomeData Stores per-channel biome mapping arrays for the Red, Green, Blue, and Alpha channels of a planet's biome mask texture. PQSData.BiomeMappingData Maps a biome color channel entry to a PQSData.KSP2BiomeType and texture index. PQSData.HeightMapInfo Stores global and local height map configuration for a planet, including displacement scale, filtering modes, pole distortion settings, and per-zone height regions. PQSData.HeightRegion Represents a localized height region defined by a height map, UV scale, height displacement, and optional sub-zone filter values. PQSData.MaterialSettings Holds the material and shader settings used for rendering a planet's surface and scaled-space representation. PQSData.PoleDecalParameters Parameters for procedural pole smoothing applied near a planet's pole. PQSData.PoleHeightSettings Represents the height decal parameters for both north and south poles of a planet. PQSDataSubZones Stores PQS sub-zone rendering data, including a normal texture array and index mappings for up to four sub-zones. PQSGeometry Manages the cached mesh geometry used by PQS terrain quad patches, including vertex positions and triangle index arrays for all edge interpolation states. PQSGlobalSettings Represents global configuration settings for the PQS planet-rendering system, including subdivision and collider parameters. PQSGlobalSettings.SubdivData Holds subdivision level bounds and terrain tessellation parameters for a PQS planet. PQSGlobalSettings.SubdivisionInfo Holds subdivision threshold multipliers and computes the per-level subdivision, collapse, and physics thresholds for a PQS instance. PQSGlobeDisplay Renders a configurable wireframe latitude/longitude grid overlay on a PQS planet sphere. PQSJobUtil Utility methods for PQS rendering jobs, including spherical UV coordinate computation and height sampling. PQSQuadTest A test MonoBehaviour that identifies the current PQS quad plane and displays positional debug information on screen. PQSQuadTest.Quad Represents a single face of a cube-sphere, storing the face transform matrix and its inverse. PQSRenderer KerbalMonoBehaviour that renders the Procedural Quad Sphere planet surface and associated ocean geometry, implementing IPQSRenderer. PQSRendererHelper API for reading per-biome properties from a PQS Material and uploading them to structured graphics buffers. PQSTargetProvider Provides camera and observer position and direction data in the local coordinate space of a PQS body transform. PQSTestCameraManager Manages a test camera rig for the PQS planetary rendering system. PrevisCameraManager Manages camera configuration and scene setup for planet rendering preview scenes in the Unity Editor. VolumeCloudManager Manages volumetric cloud rendering for planetary bodies, tracking loaded cloud models and post-process effects across flight and map views. WaitWaterDetectionAction Represents a late-update action that defers a callback invocation while waiting for water detection during planet rendering. WaterInitPerFrameAction Represents a per-frame late-update action that invokes a registered callback during water initialization. WaterManager Manages water rendering and underwater detection for planetary bodies. WaterManager.WaterDetectEntry Represents a registered entry tracking the underwater state and water surface position of an WaterManager.IWaterDetectObject. Structs BiomeLookupHashCell Represents a single cell in a biome lookup hash, storing the biome chunk indices mapped to that cell. CreateQuadDataJob A Burst-compiled parallel job that populates GPU quad data for each planet quad patch. CreateQuadStatesJob Represents a Burst-compiled job that applies pending state changes to a collection of QuadState entries. CreateUpdateListsJob Represents a Burst-compiled parallel job that populates mesh creation, normal update, visibility, and collider update lists for planetary quads. HeightSampleRequest Represents a request to sample the height at a point on a planetary surface, identified by a direction vector and UV coordinates. InterestGroup Represents a spherical region of interest defined by a world-space center position and a radius. OceanFeature Represents ocean rendering feature settings, including spectrum precision, foam, and underwater god ray quality. PQData.TesselationPositionData Represents a position and height offset for a planet surface tessellation sample. PQJob.PQ Represents a single node in the planetary quad subdivision tree, including adjacency links, transform matrices, and rendering state. PQJob.PQSJobHolder Holds a scheduled Unity job instance and its associated JobHandle. PQS.MicroSplatLight Represents a light source passed to the MicroSplat terrain rendering system. PQS.MicroSplatShadow Represents shadow data passed to the MicroSplat terrain rendering system. PQSColliderInfo Represents collider information for a PQS terrain quad, including the quad index, relative position, and pooled collider index. PQSData.BiomeSurfaceData Represents the surface biome type and associated color for a biome lookup entry. PQSRenderer.GenerateOceanSphereVertsJob Burst-compiled parallel job that transforms ocean sphere vertices into world-space positions and computes face-north matrices. PQSRenderer.GenerateOceanVertsJob Burst-compiled parallel job that projects ocean quad vertices onto the planet sphere and outputs world-space positions, planar coordinates, sphere UVs, and face-north matrices. PerBiomeInfo Represents per-biome rendering data, including small-scale texture configurations and height-based blending parameters. PerBiomeInfo_Subzones Represents per-biome small-scale texture configuration for up to four subzones. PerBiomeSmallScaleTextureConfig Represents the per-biome configuration parameters for small-scale terrain texture rendering. PerBiomeSmallScaleTextureConfig_Subzones Represents the small-scale texture subzone configuration for a single biome, including per-channel tints, brightness, and blend weights. PositionCollidersJob Represents a Burst-compiled parallel job that positions colliders by transforming offset positions from reference space to world space. QuadDataGPU Represents GPU-side data for a single planetary quad, including transform matrices, position data, and index identifiers. QuadMeshData Represents the per-vertex mesh data for a planetary terrain quad. QuadState Represents the change state of a planet terrain quad, tracking whether it is new, has modified edges, has collapsed, or has subdivided. WaterManager.UnderLandBasedWaterDetectJob Burst-compiled parallel job that tests whether objects are submerged within a land-based box-shaped water region. WaterManager.UnderWaterDetectJob Burst-compiled parallel job that tests whether objects are submerged beneath a spherical ocean surface. Interfaces IPQSOverlay Interface for a PQS overlay that provides an overlay material for planet surface rendering. IPQSRenderer Interface for a planet quad sphere renderer that responds to PQS update notifications. IPQSTerrainBlocker Interface for a PQS terrain blocker that provides mesh renderers used during the depth rendering pass. WaterManager.IWaterDetectObject Interface for objects that can be queried for position and body data during underwater detection. Enums DebugBiome Represents the color channels used to visualize biome debug data on planetary surfaces. DebugTriplanar Debug rendering mode for triplanar texture projection on planet surfaces. EdgeState Flags representing which edges of a planet terrain tile have active interpolation. OceanQuality Quality levels for ocean rendering. OceanSpectrumPrecision Precision level for ocean spectrum rendering calculations. PQSData.FilteringMode Texture filtering mode applied to height map sampling. PQSData.KSP2BiomeType Identifies the surface biome type used for physics material and texture selection on a planet. PQSRenderer.OceanType Represents the type of ocean surface rendered on a planet. QI The six axis-aligned face directions of a planet cube-sphere. QuadChild The directional child quadrant of a planetary terrain quad. QuadEdge The edge of a planet-surface quad, identified by cardinal direction. QuadPlane The axis-aligned face of a cube sphere on which a planetary quad is rendered. ShaderRefactorState Represents the planet rendering shader state, indicating whether the standard refactored shaders or the legacy shaders are in use. UnderWaterGodRayQuality Quality levels for the underwater god ray rendering effect. Delegates PQS.OnEvent Callback delegate for PQS sphere events.
