AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Rendering.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Rendering Classes AtmosphereDataModelComponent Represents a MonoBehaviour component that manages atmosphere scatter rendering data for a planet, binding an AtmosphereModel to inner and outer mesh renderer materials. AtmosphereModel Represents the atmospheric rendering model for a planet, storing Rayleigh scattering, Mie scattering, absorption, and lookup texture parameters. AtmosphereTextureBuffer Represents the set of GPU textures used to precompute and store atmosphere scattering tables, including transmittance, irradiance, and Rayleigh and Mie scattering data. AutoExposureProperties Represents the luminance range and key value settings for the auto exposure rendering pass. BoolSetting A named rendering setting that holds a boolean value. CameraClipPlaneManager Manages the active camera's far clip plane, adjusting it dynamically based on the camera's altitude above the current sphere-of-influence body. CameraEffectsSystem Manages weather and ring particle field effects associated with a scene camera. CameraFacingBillboard MonoBehaviour component that rotates the attached transform each frame to face the target camera from a given ActiveCameraGroup. CelestialBodyGIProbeDataReference Represents a reference to a CelestialBodyGIProbeData instance. CelestialBodyGIProbeManager Manages global illumination probes and ambient spherical harmonics for celestial bodies in the scene. CelestialBodyLensFlare Represents the lens flare configuration attached to a celestial body, with separate settings for flight and map views. CelestialBodyLensFlareSystem Manages lens flare rendering for a celestial body, including GPU visibility testing and flare batch submission. CelestialBodyLighting Represents a MonoBehaviour component that stores and indexes lighting override data for a celestial body. CelestialBodyLightingData Stores per-celestial-body lighting configuration data, including ambient, directional, bounce light, and skybox visibility settings. CelestialBodyMapLighting Manages per-celestial-body directional lights and lens flares in the 3D map view, updating their intensity and orientation based on camera-to-body distance. CelestialBodyPostProcess Represents a component that associates post-processing data with a celestial body. CelestialBodyRing Represents a rendered ring around a celestial body, managing mesh geometry, ring texture, light scattering, and particle fields. CelestialBodyRingGroup Manages the group of CelestialBodyRing instances that form a celestial body's ring system, coordinating material, mesh, and lighting updates. CelestialBodyRingLighting Manages the procedural lighting texture for a CelestialBodyRingGroup. CelestialBodyScaledLighting Manages scaled-space directional lighting for celestial bodies, updating light direction and intensity based on the observer position. CelestialBodyStarManager Manages per-star directional light intensity, color, and lens flare effects for celestial bodies, updating them each frame based on the observer's position. CubemapConfig Represents the cubemap rendering configuration, defining render parameters for each quality level. CubemapReflectionSystem Manages cubemap-based environment reflections, coordinating observer and celestial body cubemap rendering each frame. CubemapSettings Represents cubemap rendering settings as a ScriptableObject asset. DecalSystem Manages decal registration, camera assignment, and rendering lifecycle for the active scene camera. DirectionalLightShadowController Represents a MonoBehaviour controller that configures directional light shadow parameters for the NGSS soft-shadow system. DrawMeshRendererToRawImage Renders one or more MeshRenderer objects to a UnityEngine.UI.RawImage UI element using a command buffer and orthographic projection. DynamicAmbientLight Manages dynamic ambient lighting, skybox materials, and fog settings across in-game environments. DynamicDecalSystem Manages footprint VFX decal events for a Kerbal EVA, firing surface-contextual effects from the left and right foot transforms during walk animation events. FXBase Base component for KSP visual effects that manages particle systems, trail renderers, and line renderers and corrects their positions on physics reference frame changes. GraphicsManager Manages and coordinates the game's graphics subsystems, including lighting, shadows, post-processing, decals, and celestial body rendering. GraphicsSettings Represents the collection of configurable graphics settings for the game. LightLOD Manages level-of-detail for a Unity UnityEngine.Light component, adjusting intensity and shadow settings at configurable distance thresholds. LightLODGroup Manages a group of LightLOD instances and updates their level-of-detail state each frame based on distance from the active camera. LightingSettingsLua Exposes lighting graphics settings to a Lua script environment by registering callbacks for atmospheric scattering, global illumination, and reflection parameters. LightingSystem Manages the game's scene lighting by coordinating star, atmosphere, volume cloud, reflection, and skybox subsystems. MaterialSetDirection Represents a component that sets a direction value on the attached Renderer material. ObjectAssemblyLighting Manages time-of-day lighting in the Object Assembly Building, blending lightmaps, fog colors, and reflection cubemaps between day, evening, and night states. OverrideLightingData Represents the data for a named lighting override, including spherical Gaussian settings, orbital intensity values, and color. PanelBlurSystem Renders a screen-space blur into a global shader texture for use by UI panel materials. ParticleFieldModifier Manages a PAParticleField for a CelestialBodyRing, enabling the field and updating its color, density, and orbital force when the camera is within ring bounds. PlanetSettingsLua Registers planet rendering settings (scatter, collider visibility, and low-quality mode) as callbacks on a Lua script environment. PlanetShineManager Manages planet shine lighting by tracking visible celestial bodies and computing reflected light intensity and lens flare contributions each frame. PlanetShinePreset A ScriptableObject asset containing configuration data for the planet shine lighting effect. PostProcessData Represents the post-processing configuration asset for a celestial body, including the associated profile and altitude-bounded auto-exposure settings. PostProcessEventsManager Manages post-process rendering effects tied to tutorial lifecycle events, adding a TutorialOverlay effect when a tutorial starts and removing it when the tutorial ends. PostProcessVolumeOverride Manages a post-process volume's enabled state, weight, and auto-exposure property blending based on celestial body lighting data. PostProcessingSettingsLua Represents the Lua scripting bridge for post-processing and tutorial overlay graphics settings. PostProcessingSystem Manages post-processing volume overrides for the flight, map, and OAB camera contexts, blending per-star and per-body profiles by altitude as the observed body changes. PrefabLensFlare Manages a ProFlare lens flare effect attached to a prefab, scaling intensity and visibility by camera distance and active camera group. PrefabLight Represents a prefab light controller that manages the color and intensity of child UnityEngine.Light components, with optional time-of-day reactivity and animated enable/disable transitions. PresetQualityLevel Represents a set of rendering quality settings that define a named graphics preset. ProceduralFunctions Utility methods for procedural geometry computations. ProceduralPartData Represents the configuration data for a procedural part's skinned mesh renderer and per-axis rotation settings. ProceduralShaderData Manages per-frame shader property updates (texture offset and rotation) for a collection of procedural parts driven by an OffsetSliderSystem. RenderScalePhysicsRaycaster Physics raycaster variant for cameras rendering into a supersampled target. RenderScalePresenter Renders one or more scene cameras into a supersampled target, then presents it to the backbuffer. UI cameras continue to render at native resolution. ScaledCloudDataModelComponent Manages the scaled-space cloud rendering layer for a planet, including materials and configuration data from a ScaledCloudConfiguration. Setting A base class for named rendering settings. ShadowCascadeSplits Represents the split configuration for shadow cascades, specifying the cascade count and distance split values. ShadowConfig Represents the shadow rendering configuration parameters, including light bias, NGSS soft-shadow sampling, PCSS, denoiser, and cascade blend settings. ShadowMapRenderer Renders a shadow map for scaled-space objects using a directional light source. ShadowSettings Stores shadow configuration presets for the VAB, surface, and orbital camera contexts at each quality level. ShadowSystem Manages directional light shadow quality, transitioning between surface and orbital shadow configurations based on the player's altitude and active game context. SkyboxManager Manages galaxy skybox exposure and rotation based on observer position, celestial body lighting data, and the galactic coordinate frame. SphericalGaussianSettings Represents configuration settings for Spherical Gaussian lighting approximation. TimeOfDayManager Manages time-of-day lighting for a configured surface position, toggling prefab lights at sunrise and sunset and updating a global sun shader parameter. Structs CelestialBodyGIProbeData Represents global illumination probe data for a celestial body, combining spherical harmonics and up to three spherical Gaussian lobes for ambient and directional lighting. CubemapRenderLevels Represents the rendering parameters for a cubemap quality level. DensityProfileLayer Represents a single layer in an atmospheric density profile, defined by exponential and linear scattering terms. LightData Represents the set of light sources, renderers, and auxiliary rendering data associated with a single celestial body. LightingSystem.LayeredLight Represents a layered light setup with a primary and accent light under a shared parent. ParticleFieldRingData Represents the data required to configure a particle field ring for a celestial body. PlanetShinePresetData Represents the preset data for the planet shine rendering effect. RenderCameraParameters Represents the parameters used to configure a camera for a rendering pass. SphericalGaussian Represents a spherical Gaussian lobe used to approximate directional lighting, defined by an amplitude, axis, and sharpness. Interfaces ICameraRenderStack Interface for a layered camera render stack that manages render cameras, applies camera shots, and provides coordinate space conversion utilities. ICameraRenderView Interface for a camera view that manages its render stacks and rendering lifecycle. Enums DirectionalLightShadowController.ShadowMapResolution Shadow map resolution tiers available for a directional light. PostProfileMode The time-of-day blending mode applied to post-processing profiles. PostPropertyBlendMode The blend mode used when interpolating post-processing property values. ProceduralPartData.TransformDir The local-space axis direction used when computing procedural part rotations. QualityLevel Represents the available rendering quality levels. RenderSpaceType The coordinate space in which a scene object is rendered. TextureQualityLevel The available texture resolution quality levels. VolumePriority Represents the priority level of a rendering volume, ordered from broadest global scope to narrowest overlay scope. Delegates FXBase.FXCreatedEventHandler Delegate for callbacks invoked when a new FXBase instance awakens. GraphicsSettings.SettingChangedHandler Callback invoked when a graphics setting value changes.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Rendering.impl.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Rendering.impl Classes BasicCameraRigSolution Represents the standard camera rig solution, managing gimbal state, camera positioning, input processing, and terrain collision for in-flight and scene cameras. CameraRenderStackBase A base class for ICameraRenderStack implementations, providing default camera shot routing and coordinate-space conversion utilities via the main render camera. CaptureCameraRigSolution Represents a camera rig solution for the capture camera, managing gimbal and camera transforms in response to orbit, pan, and zoom input. CelestialBodyCubemapView A cubemap view that renders a celestial body's scaled-space geometry into an environment cubemap. ChaseCameraRigSolution Represents a chase camera rig solution that follows a target by managing gimbal state, position, and orientation. CubemapViewBase A base class for rendering environment cubemaps one face per frame using a camera and command buffer. FlightCameraRenderStack_Physics Camera render stack for the physics render space during flight, hosting the physics main camera, cubemap camera, and post-process layer. FlightCameraRenderStack_Scaled Camera render stack for the flight scene's scaled-space view, managing the main and cubemap cameras that render distant celestial bodies and the background environment. FlyOverTestCameraRigSolution A test implementation of ICameraRigSolution that fixes the camera at the gimbal origin for fly-over scenario testing. FreeFlightCamera Represents a free-flight camera transform that implements ICameraShotProvider to supply a camera shot for the flight view. ObserverCubemapView Represents an environment cubemap view rendered from an observer's camera position. StationaryCameraRigSolution Represents a stationary camera rig solution that fixes the camera at a position in space while tracking a moving vessel. TestingCameraRigSolution A testing implementation of ICameraRigSolution that drives the camera gimbal with automatic constant-speed heading orbit. UniverseCameraViewBase A base class for universe camera views that manages registered ICameraRenderStack instances organized by render space type and render order. UniverseCameraViewBase.CameraRenderStackEntry Represents a registered camera render stack entry, associating an ICameraRenderStack with its render space type and sort order. UniverseFlightCameraView Represents a universe camera view for in-flight rendering, coordinating separate scaled-space and physics-space camera stacks. VABFlightCamera Camera shot provider that overrides the flight-view camera with a VABFlightCameraShot when activated in the VAB scene. Enums CubemapViewBase.CubemapViewType Identifies the rendering context of a cubemap view.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.ScriptInterop.html.summary: Namespace KSP.ScriptInterop Classes ScriptRunner Represents a script runner that executes Lua scripts loaded from asset keys or from inline source strings. TypeInteropAttribute Attribute that registers a data type mapping for script interop, associating a C# type with a nickname and optional alternate names. Structs FormatOptions Represents formatting options for script interop output. Interfaces ICompiledScript Interface for a compiled script, providing its name, source file path, last modified time, and compiled bytecode. IObjectConverter Interface for converting between .NET objects and IScriptValue instances. IReferenceConverter<T> Interface for converting between IScriptValue instances and nullable .NET struct references of type T. IRunScriptInterop Interface for running scripts synchronously and asynchronously through the script interop system. IScriptClass Interface for a named class in the script interop layer, supporting registration of child classes and CLR methods. IScriptClosure Interface for an invocable script closure. IScriptCode Interface for script code objects in the script interop layer. IScriptEnvironment Interface for a scripting environment that supports script execution, type registration, compilation, and environment forking. IScriptFactory Interface for creating IScriptInterop instances. IScriptInterop Interface for accessing script execution environments, including the root and asset compiler environments. IScriptObject Interface for objects accessible from the script interop layer. IScriptRunner Interface for executing Lua scripts from asset references or string source. IScriptThread Interface for a script execution thread that manages coroutine lifecycle and tracks ready, finished, and errored states. IScriptValue Interface for a script value, providing nil inspection and conversion to .NET types. ISourceScript Interface for source scripts. ITypeInterop Interface for converting .NET objects to and from script values. ITypeWriter Interface for writing a MoonSharp.Interpreter.DynValue to a string or System.Text.StringBuilder. IValueConverter<T> Interface for converting between IScriptValue instances and .NET values of type T.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.Definitions.html.title: Namespace KSP.Sim.Definitions | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.Definitions.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Sim.Definitions Classes CelestialBodyCore Represents the serializable top-level definition of a celestial body, holding its CelestialBodyData payload and serialization metadata. CelestialBodyData Represents the serialized data definition for a celestial body, including its physical, atmospheric, rotational, and decorative properties. CelestialBodyRingData Represents the ring data for a celestial body, defining inner and outer radii and a density curve. Data_ModuleActions Data definition for custom module action group mappings, tracking per-action reassignments from their default action groups. InterstellarNeighborhood Represents a named interstellar neighborhood definition containing a set of stars at a given location. InterstellarStar Represents the definition data for an interstellar star, including its name, offset, plane orientation, and motion. InterstellarStarMotion Represents motion parameters for an interstellar star. LocalizedFieldAttribute Attribute that associates a localization key with a field declaration. ModuleAction A DelegateAction implementing IModuleAction, with a context key initialized to the delegate method name and a toggleable action state. ModuleActionGroupAction Represents a module action that wraps a delegate and can be assigned to a KSPActionGroup. ModuleData A base class for serializable data definitions associated with a simulation part module. ModuleDataList Represents a serializable collection of ModuleData entries keyed by their runtime type. ModuleProperty<T> Represents a module data property that extends Property<T> with IModuleProperty support, including optional read-only access and a custom string representation delegate. PAMDisplayControlAttribute Attribute applied to fields to control their display in the Part Action Menu, including sort order and context visibility. PartBehaviourModule Abstract base class for part behaviour modules, providing data module lifecycle, action group actions, and update dispatch for flight and OAB contexts. PartCore Represents the top-level container for a serialized part definition, holding part and module data with versioned JSON deserialization support. PartData Represents the serializable data definition for a spacecraft part, including physical properties, attachment rules, resource containers, part modules, and OAB editor settings. PartModuleLocalization Localization key constants for part module UI fields. PartModuleTooltipLocalization Localization key constants and resource-rate formatting utilities for part module tooltips. ProceduralPartCore Represents the serializable core of a procedural part, pairing a ProceduralPartDefinition with its serialization version and external-data flag. ResourceCore Represents a serializable resource definition, holding a ResourceDefinition or a ResourceRecipeDefinition along with versioning metadata. SteppedRangeAttribute Attribute that marks a numeric field with a stepped range, specifying minimum, maximum, and step increment values. SymmetrySetData Represents the serialized data for a part symmetry set, storing the symmetry type, anchor part, and all associated part references. SymmetrySetDataSync Utility for synchronizing module data between symmetrically-linked assembly parts. Structs AssemblyDefinition Represents the serializable definition of a game assembly, including its name, simulation object type, version, and ground offset. AttachNodeDefinition Represents the definition of a part attachment node, including its position, orientation, type, and joint configuration. AttachRules Represents the attachment rules for a part, defining which attachment modes and behaviors are permitted. CelestialBodyDefinition Represents a celestial body definition, pairing a string key with optional CelestialBodyProperties. CelestialBodyProperties Represents the definition data for a celestial body, including physical, atmospheric, ocean, rotation, and science parameters. CelestialBodyProperties.ScienceParams Represents the science data multipliers and altitude thresholds for a celestial body. CelestialBodyPropertiesIncremental Represents a partial override of celestial body simulation properties, applying only the non-null field values. ColonyDefinition Represents a colony definition. CrewMemberDefinition Represents the definition data for a crew member. DeltaVDefinition Represents a delta-V definition within the simulation. FlagComponentDefinition Represents the definition data for a flag component, including its name and location details. ManeuverPlanDefinition Represents a maneuver plan definition. MapData Represents height and alpha data for a map entry. MiniBiomeDefinition Represents a mini-biome definition, storing the tag key, localized tag name, and tag key identifier. OrbiterDefinition Represents the visual display settings for an orbital path, including orbit and node colors and camera distance thresholds. PartDefinition Represents the definition of a spacecraft part, containing its identifier, data properties, and serialized module list. PartDefinitionContainer Represents a serializable container associating a part GUID and name with its PartDefinition. PartModuleResourceSetting Represents a resource configuration entry for a part module, specifying the resource name, consumption or production rate, and acceptance threshold. PartOwnerDefinition Represents a definition marker identifying a part owner entity. PartProperties Represents the raw serialized properties of a part definition, including physical, thermal, attachment, and resource configuration. PartResourceCostDefinition Represents the resource cost of a part as a named resource and unit quantity. PhysicsOwnerDefinition Represents a definition component that marks a simulation entity as a physics owner. ResourceConsumerComponentDefinition Represents a component definition marking a simulation entity as a resource consumer. ResourceContainerComponentDefinition Represents a resource container component definition. ResourceGeneratorComponentDefinition Represents the definition data for a resource generator simulation component. ResourceOwnerComponentDefinition Definition component marking an entity as a resource owner. RigidbodyDefinition Represents the definition of a rigidbody in the physics simulation. ScienceStorageDefinition Represents a science storage definition. SerializedActionGroupAction Represents the serialized form of a ModuleActionGroupAction, storing the action name and group identifier. SerializedColonyData Represents the serialized state of a colony, including active flights and delivery routes. SerializedLegacyModuleData Represents a serialized snapshot of a legacy part module, including its name, type, field names, field types, and raw field values. SerializedModuleData Represents the serialized form of a ModuleData object for persistent storage. SerializedPartModule Represents a serialized snapshot of a part module, storing its name, component type, behaviour type, and associated module data. SerializedPredefinedColonyObject Represents the serialized state of a PredefinedColonyObject, capturing population fill, telemetry, and CommNet source configuration. SerializedPredefinedSimObject Represents the serialized form of a PredefinedSimObject. SerializedResourceInfo Represents the serialized resource relationship data for a part, describing the resources it consumes, generates, and contains. SettingsDefinitions String keys for game settings entries covering audio volumes, graphics options, and gameplay preferences. SettingsProperties Represents a named collection of SettingsProperty entries with a validity state. SettingsProperty Represents the definition of a single game settings property. SimulationObjectDefinition Represents the definition data for a simulation object. SimulationObjectDefinitionContainer Represents a container pairing a SimulationObjectDefinition with its associated component definitions. StagingDefinition Represents the staging definition for a simulated part. TelemetryDefinition Represents a marker struct identifying a telemetry definition in the simulation. UniverseDefinition Represents the definition entry for the simulation universe. WaypointComponentDefinition Represents a waypoint component definition. Interfaces IModuleAction Interface for a module-scoped action that extends IAction and IModuleDataContext, adding a context key and a toggleable state. IModuleDataContext Interface for objects that provide a context key for module data lookups. IModuleProperty Interface for a module property that combines read and write property access with a module data context. Enums ActionBarDisplayMode Display mode for the action bar, indicating whether it represents a vessel, Kerbal, or colony context. AttachNodeMethod The physics attachment method used for a part attach node. CommandControlState The control state of a command part module. MenuLocationEnum Specifies the game location context in which a menu or UI element is displayed. PartBehaviourModule.PartBackingModes The active backing context for a part behaviour module, indicating whether it is operating in flight, OAB, or no context. SettingTypeEnum The type of UI control used to display a setting. SphereOfInfluenceCalculationType The method used to calculate a body's sphere of influence. SymmetryType Represents the type of symmetry applied when placing parts. TransformDirAxis The directional axis of a transform, representing the X, Y, or Z axis. VesselCategory VesselControlState Represents the control state of a vessel. Delegates ModuleActionGroupAction.ActionChanged Delegate for callbacks invoked when the action state changes.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.DeltaV.html.title: Namespace KSP.Sim.DeltaV | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.DeltaV.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Sim.DeltaV Classes DeltaVCalc Represents the computed delta-V results for a rocket stage, including vacuum, sea-level, and actual values for delta-V, specific impulse, thrust, and thrust-to-weight ratio. DeltaVEngineExtensions Extension methods for DeltaVEngineInfo lists. DeltaVEngineInfo Represents delta-V related information for a single engine, including thrust, specific impulse, and propellant data. DeltaVEngineResourcePartExtensions Extension methods on System.Collections.Generic.List<T> of DeltaVEngineResourcePartInfo for querying resource parts by part identity and decoupling stage. DeltaVEngineResourcePartInfo Represents a resource-supplying part associated with an engine during delta-V calculations. DeltaVEngineStageSet Manages the set of engine and stage data entries used in delta-v calculations for a VesselDeltaVComponent. DeltaVEngineStageSet.StageSortingInstance Comparer for DeltaVStageInfo that sorts stages in descending order by stage number. DeltaVExtensions API for delta-V staging queries, mode detection, and situation-based value selection. DeltaVPartExtensions Extension methods for querying System.Collections.Generic.List<T> collections of DeltaVPartInfo by part identity and stage. DeltaVPartInfo Represents per-part delta-V data including staging, mass, and module references for a vessel's delta-V calculation. DeltaVPartInfo.PartStageFuelMass Tracks the fuel mass state of a part for a specific staging phase, including start mass, end mass, and resource consumption. DeltaVPartInfo.PartStageFuelMass.PartResources Holds the resource container group and tracks consumed resource units for a part during a staging phase. DeltaVPropellantInfo Represents propellant availability and burn-time data for a single propellant type within a vessel delta-V calculation. DeltaVStageInfo Represents computed delta-V data for a single rocket stage, including mass breakdown, ISP, TWR, thrust, and delta-V values across vacuum, sea-level, and actual conditions. IDeltaVPartExtensions Extension methods for IDeltaVPart that query part module data by module type. VesselDeltaVComponent ObjectComponent that computes delta-V for a vessel or ship assembly, organized by engine staging. Interfaces IDeltaVPart Interface for a part in the delta-V calculation system, exposing mass, staging, atmospheric, and resource container data. Enums DeltaVSituationOptions The atmospheric situation options used for delta-V calculations. VesselDeltaVComponent.Mode Represents the operational mode of a VesselDeltaVComponent, distinguishing between no target, a ship assembly, and an in-flight vessel.

ContainedResourceDefinition Represents the definition of a resource contained within a part, including capacity, initial amount, and staging configuration. Edge Concrete implementation of IFlowEdge representing a connection edge in the resource flow graph, with factory methods for creating attachment, decoupler, fuel line, and strut edge types. FlowGraph Directed graph representing the resource flow connections between parts in a vessel or Object Assembly. FlowInstructionConfig Represents the configuration for a resource flow instruction, including the target node, resource, flow mode, direction, priority, and flow unit values. FlowRequestExtensions Extension methods for searching resource flow request handle dictionaries. IFlowEdgeExtensions Extension methods for IFlowEdge. IReadOnlyListEqualityComparerExtensions Extension methods that add IndexOf overloads to System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList<T> with optional equality comparer and index range support. IReadOnlyPriorityGroupCollectionExtensions Extension methods for IReadOnlyPriorityGroupCollection<TElement>. IResourceContainerExtensions Extension methods for IResourceContainer. IResourceContainerReadOnlyDatabaseExtensions Extension methods for IResourceContainerReadOnly that compute resource mass values using a ResourceDefinitionDatabase. ListEqualityComparerExtensions Extension methods for System.Collections.Generic.List<T> that add IndexOf and Remove overloads accepting a custom System.Collections.Generic.IEqualityComparer<T>. PriorityGroupCollection<TElement> Represents a mutable collection that organizes elements into priority groups, implementing IPriorityGroupCollection<TElement>. PriorityGroupCollection<TElement>.HighToLowPrioritySorter Comparer that sorts priority values from highest to lowest. PriorityGroupCollection<TElement>.LowToHighPrioritySorter Comparer that sorts priority values from lowest to highest. ResourceContainer Represents a resource container that tracks stored and capacity amounts for a collection of resources identified by ResourceDefinitionID. ResourceContainerGroup Represents a composite group of ResourceContainer instances treated as a single IResourceContainer. ResourceContainerGroupSequence Represents an ordered sequence of ResourceContainerGroup instances that together form a combined resource container. ResourceDefinitionData Represents the runtime data for a resource definition, including physical properties for direct resources or ingredient composition for recipe-based resources. ResourceDefinitionData.RecipeProperties Represents the ingredient composition and mass properties of a recipe-based resource. ResourceDefinitionData.ResourceProperties Represents the physical and gameplay properties of a resource, including mass, volume, flow mode, and display settings. ResourceDefinitionDatabase Represents a database of resource and recipe definitions for the simulation resource system. ResourceDefinitionDatabase.CircularRecipeException Exception thrown when a circular recipe dependency is detected in the resource definition database. ResourceFlowPriorityQuerySolver Solves priority-grouped resource flow queries over a directed flow graph, computing inbound and outbound node orderings by distance from a root node. ResourceFlowRequestBroker Mediates resource flow request allocation and lifecycle for a single IFlowNode through a ResourceFlowRequestManager. ResourceFlowRequestCommandConfig Represents the configuration for a resource flow request command. ResourceFlowRequestManager Manages resource flow requests for a part owner, coordinating request registration, prioritization, and delivery via a flow graph. ResourceFlowRequestManager.ManagedRequestWrapper Wraps a resource flow request, tracking its handle, target node, commands, instructions, and resolution state. ResourceRecipeIngredientDefinitionOverride Represents a serializable override for a resource recipe ingredient definition, specifying name, units per recipe unit, and flow mode. ResourceSystemUtilities Static utility methods and shared types for the resource system simulation layer. ResourceSystemUtilities.RefComparer<T> Equality comparer that uses reference identity rather than value equality. ResourceSystemUtilities.ResourceSystemException Exception thrown when a fatal error occurs in the resource system. Structs ContainedResourceData Represents a resource stored in a part container, including its capacity, stored amount, and staging and recipe metadata. FlowRequestResolutionState Represents the resolution state of a resource flow request across a simulation tick. ResourceDefinition Represents the definition data for a resource in the simulation resource system. ResourceDefinitionID Represents a unique identifier for a resource definition. ResourceFlowRequestHandle Represents an immutable handle that uniquely identifies a resource flow request by its numeric ID. ResourceFlowRequestManager.RequestPriorityContainerGroupKey Composite key pairing an IFlowNode and a priority value, used to group resource flow requests by node and priority level. ResourceRecipeDefinition Represents the definition of a resource recipe, including its display name, icon, ingredients, and VFX fuel type. ResourceRecipeIngredientDefinition Represents a single ingredient in a resource recipe, specifying the resource name and its quantity per recipe unit. Interfaces IFlowEdge Interface for a connection edge in the resource flow graph, representing a link between resource containers with properties governing flow traversal, crossfeed, and structural boundary behavior. IFlowNode Interface for a node in the resource flow graph that exposes resource containers. IPriorityGroupCollection<TElement> Interface for a mutable collection that organizes elements into priority groups, extending IReadOnlyPriorityGroupCollection<TElement> with add, remove, and clear operations. IReadOnlyPriorityGroupCollection<TElement> Interface for a read-only collection that organizes elements into groups by priority. IResourceContainer Interface for a mutable resource container that extends IResourceContainerReadOnly with write operations to add, remove, fill, dump, and override stored resource quantities and capacities. IResourceContainerReadOnly Interface for read-only access to the contents and capacity of a resource container. Enums FlowDirection The direction of resource flow, either inbound or outbound. ResourceSystemUtilities.ErrorReportMode The level at which a resource system error is reported or escalated. ResourceTransferMode The mode of resource transfer between parts.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.State.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Sim.State Classes CelestialBodyState Represents the serializable state of a celestial body. Structs ActionGroupStates Represents the activation states of one or more action groups. AttachNodeState Represents the serialized state of a part attachment node, including the attached part identity and dynamic position and orientation. ColonyState Represents the simulation state of a colony. ContainedResourceState Represents the serializable state of a single contained resource, including its name, stored quantity, and capacity. CrewMemberState Represents the simulation state of a crew member, including part assignment, seat index, and current CrewState. CrewMemberViewGraphUpdate Represents a view-graph update for a crew member, specifying the PartComponent the crew member occupies and the IInternalSeat assigned to them. DeltaVSituation Represents a situational snapshot used in delta-V calculations, capturing the celestial body, atmosphere presence, and altitude. DeltaVState Represents the delta-V state of a vessel, including vacuum, sea-level, and actual delta-V totals and total burn time. FlagComponentState Represents the serializable state of a flag component, including its physics mode. FlightCtrlState Represents the current state of flight control inputs for a vessel, including throttle, axis inputs, and trim values. FlightCtrlStateIncremental Represents a partial set of flight control inputs that can be selectively applied to a FlightCtrlState. ForceState Represents the state of a force applied in local space, including its ForceType, value, and position. FramePositionState Represents the position and rotation of a transform within a reference frame. GeographicPositionState Represents the geographic position of an entity relative to a reference body, capturing latitude, longitude, altitude from radius, and heading. KeplerOrbitState Represents the Keplerian orbital elements for a simulated orbit. KerbalState Represents the simulation state of a Kerbal, including ladder attachment and flag-carrying status. ManeuverPlanState Represents the state of a maneuver plan, holding a list of scheduled maneuver nodes. MotionHierarchy Represents a node in the simulation motion hierarchy, storing the frame type, relative velocities, and child nodes. PartOwnerState Represents the state of a part owner, including its virtual part connections. PartState Represents the serialized state of a part, including position, rotation, attach nodes, resources, and simulation properties. PartViewGraphUpdate Represents a position and rotation update for a part in the view graph. PhysicsOwnerState Represents the physics ownership state of a simulated object, including its total mass and physics mode. ResourceConsumerComponentRateState Represents the resource consumption rate state for a single resource consumer component. ResourceConsumerComponentState Represents the state of a resource consumer component. ResourceContainerComponentState Represents the serialized state of a resource container component, holding a map of resource names to their contained state. ResourceGeneratorComponentState Represents the state of a resource generator simulation component. ResourceOwnerComponentState Represents the simulation state for a resource owner component. RigidbodyState Represents the physical state of a rigidbody within a reference frame, including local position, rotation, velocity, angular velocity, and mass. ScienceStorageState Represents the science storage state, holding collected research reports and the set of reports currently being transmitted. SimulationObjectState Represents the state snapshot of a simulation object, containing its frame-relative position. SimulationObjectStateContainer Represents the state snapshot of a simulation object, bundling an optional object-level state and a per-component state dictionary. StagePartsState Represents the state of a single staging group, holding the stage ID, active status, associated part IDs, and delta-V situation. StagingState Represents the staging configuration of a vessel, including available stages and unassigned parts. SurfaceTeleportState Represents the state of a surface teleport, including the reference body, geographic position, and vertical speed. TelemetryState Represents the telemetry state. TransformHierarchy Represents a snapshot of a transform node's position, rotation, reference frame type, and children within the simulation transform hierarchy. UniverseState Represents the current state of the universe, storing the universal time. VesselState Represents the serializable state of a vessel, including flight controls, display modes, autopilot configuration, physics mode, and situational data.

AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.html.summary: Namespace KSP.Sim Classes ActionGroupUtils Utility methods for querying and filtering KSPActionGroup values. AttachNodeData Represents the runtime data for a single part attachment node in the simulation. BaseAction Represents a base action definition, holding display and control metadata for an input action. BaseEvent Represents a configurable event on a part module, including GUI display settings and interaction parameters. BaseField Represents a serializable field definition with GUI display and editor configuration metadata. BasicCameraRig Represents a basic camera rig that manages a set of mode-specific solutions and routes updates to the active solution. BuiltInObjectComponentDefList Provides singleton definition instances, type tokens, and a definition array for the built-in simulation object components. CameraInputState Represents the current camera input state, capturing control flags and axis values for zoom, pan, orbit, and roll operations. CameraTweakables Represents a serializable ScriptableObject storing tweakable camera parameters such as sensitivity, field-of-view limits, distance bounds, and terrain-collision blend settings. CaptureFrameRotationProvider Represents an IDynamicFrameRotationProvider that supplies rotation by sampling the reference body transform of an IUniverseObserver. CaptureGimbalPositionProvider Captures a gimbal's current position from an IUniverseObserver. CelestialFrameRotationProvider Provides the non-rotating celestial reference frame for the observer's current reference body. ChaseFrameRotationProvider Provides rotation for a dynamic reference frame by smoothly interpolating toward an IUniverseObserver's current orientation. ClassFactory Attribute that associates a class with its factory implementation type and data type. ConnectionGraph Manages an asynchronous job-based connection graph that computes path connectivity and distance between ConnectionGraphNode nodes. ConnectionGraphNode Represents a node in the vessel communication connection graph, storing ownership, position, range, and connectivity state. DirectedGraphExtensions Extension methods for DirectedGraph<TNodeRef, TEdgeData>. DirectedGraphPriorityWalker<TNodeRef, TEdgeData> A base class for walking a directed graph and grouping nodes into priority-ordered buckets. DirectedGraph<TNodeRef, TEdgeData> A base class for a directed graph with typed node references and per-edge data. DirectedGraph<TNodeRef, TEdgeData>.DirectedEdge Represents a directed edge connecting two nodes in the graph. DirectedGraph<TNodeRef, TEdgeData>.NodeEdgeState Stores the outbound and cached inbound edges for a single node. EngagedContract Represents a contract pairing an event type with its associated callback. EventDrivenFX A MonoBehaviour that subscribes to launch-sequence stage events and activates or deactivates a paired visual effects prefab and audio event in response. GimbalStateUtils Utility methods for computing camera GimbalState values from Unity transforms and rotations. Hacks Static utility methods for creating FXGroup instances from Unity prefabs. HorizonFrameRotationProvider Provides rotation for the local horizon reference frame derived from a universe observer's position relative to its reference body. KSPActionAttribute Attribute that associates a KSPActionGroup and KSPActionType with a member. KSPDefinitionAttribute Marks a declaration as a KSP definition. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.impl.CollisionMan.title: Class CollisionManager | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.Sim.impl.CollisionMan.summary: Class CollisionManager Manage PhysX interactions to ignore collisions between colliders in the same vessel. The primary mechanism for this is Physics.IgnoreCollision(). However, doing that for every collider combination scales O(n^2). Scalability problems become measurable around 100 parts, and can take several minutes after 900+ parts. It is much faster to only set up ignores for parts that are actually touching. This scales close to O(n) with the collider count. However, it's difficult to test this in advance. So we just let PhysX tell us which are touching, because that's what it's designed to do. Record each collider as being "owned" by a vessel (guid) Wait for PhysX to report a contact. CollisionMonitor receives a Physics.ContactModifyEvent for the contact. (The callback is offthread) If the contact is between to colliders owned by the same vessel GUID, void the contact. (This allows them to pass through as if already ignored) Log the contact in a thread-safe structure. At some later point on the main thread, read the log, set do the Physics.IgnoreCollision(), and (optionally) log again so that it can be undone. There are some cases that require special handling: Collider setups that won't generate Physics.ContactModifyEvent() callbacks (usually because they are temporarily on the same Rigidbody), but need to be ignored anyway. It is necessary to call Physics.IgnoreCollision() in advance. ("always ignore") Some ignores need to persist despite the collider being removed from the vessel. ("persist after removal"). This is usually a separable item (e.g., engine shroud) significantly overlaps other colliders (e.g., the engine it contains). If the ignore is removed too soon, the resulting contact event can lead to RUD. AssemblyActionGroups ObjectActionGroups implementation that manages action group assignments for an ObjectAssembly. AtmosphereTransitionVFXHandling.AtmosphericCrossfadeData Holds the particle system, material, and color data needed to crossfade a single VFX effect during atmosphere transitions. AtmosphericFxSystem Manages atmospheric visual effects for a vessel, coordinating vapor, surface interaction, and reentry FX using telemetry-driven context data. BodyMotionFrame A MotionFrame for celestial bodies that sources relative angular velocity directly from the motion model. CaptureMarker Represents a capture event marker on a patched orbit, extending OrbitMarker with relative distance and speed at the point of capture. CelestialBodyBehavior View component that binds celestial body rendering and surface behavior to a CelestialBodyComponent, implementing ISurfaceProvider. CelestialBodyComponent Represents a celestial body in the simulation, implementing position, rotation, linear motion, angular motion, and rigid-body drivers. CharacterForce Represents a force applied by a character, implementing IForce with a direction, magnitude, and sign. CliInputOverride ClimbKerbalCharacterStateHandler Handles the ladder-climbing character state for a Kerbal, managing sub-state transitions for docking, climbing, and dismounting. CloseApproachMarker Represents an OrbitMarker placed at the closest approach point between two orbits, capturing relative distance and speed. CollisionManager Manage PhysX interactions to ignore collisions between colliders in the same vessel. The primary mechanism for this is Physics.IgnoreCollision(). However, doing that for every collider combination scales O(n^2). Scalability problems become measurable around 100 parts, and can take several minutes after 900+ parts. It is much faster to only set up ignores for parts that are actually touching. This scales close to O(n) with the collider count. However, it's difficult to test this in advance. So we just let PhysX tell us which are touching, because that's what it's designed to do. Record each collider as being "owned" by a vessel (guid) Wait for PhysX to report a contact. CollisionMonitor receives a Physics.ContactModifyEvent for the contact. (The callback is offthread) If the contact is between to colliders owned by the same vessel GUID, void the contact. (This allows them to pass through as if already ignored) Log the contact in a thread-safe structure. At some later point on the main thread, read the log, set do the Physics.IgnoreCollision(), and (optionally) log again so that it can be undone. There are some cases that require special handling: Collider setups that won't generate Physics.ContactModifyEvent() callbacks (usually because they are temporarily on the same Rigidbody), but need to be ignored anyway. It is necessary to call Physics.IgnoreCollision() in advance. ("always ignore") Some ignores need to persist despite the collider being removed from the vessel. ("persist after removal"). This is usually a separable item (e.g., engine shroud) significantly overlaps other colliders (e.g., the engine it contains). If the ignore is removed too soon, the resulting contact event can lead to RUD. CollisionMarker An OrbitMarker that marks the collision transition point on a patched orbit. UIActionBinder Abstract base class for UI components that resolve and bind an IAction from a data context by key. UIValueBinder<T> A base class for strongly-typed UI value binders that adds typed get, set, and bind operations on top of UIValueBinder. UIValueNumberBinder Abstract base class for numeric UI value binders that bind a double value with a configurable mapped range. UIValue_ReadEnum_LocatorSet A UIValueEnumBinder that repositions or orients an indicator element to a set of enum-value-mapped locators, with optional animated transitions. UIValue_ReadEnum_MaterialSet UIValueEnumBinder that maps bound enum string values to Unity materials and applies the matching material to a set of target renderers. UIValue_ReadEnum_ObjectSet UI value binder that drives the active state of target GameObjects based on a mapped enum string value. UIValue_ReadEnum_SelectableColorSet Represents a UI value binder that maps bound enum values to UnityEngine.UI.ColorBlock configurations applied to a set of target UnityEngine.UI.Selectable components. UIValue_ReadEnum_SetInteractible Reads a bound enum value and sets the interactable state of a target UnityEngine.UI.Selectable or CanvasGroup based on per-enum-value configuration. UIValue_ReadEnum_TextSet A UIValueEnumBinder that displays a mapped text string and color for each enum value, falling back to a configurable default when the value is not mapped. UIValue_SAS_Wheel Represents the SAS mode selection wheel UI, handling radial navigation and mode activation via flight controller input. UIValue_SAS_Wheel.GroupGameObj Represents a group of GameObjects in the SAS selection wheel, with an index tracking the current selection. UIValue_WriteEnum_BoolSet A UIValueEnumBinder that drives a configurable set of bool UIValueBinder targets, toggling each based on whether its associated enum value matches the currently bound value. UIValue_WriteEnum_Button A UIValueEnumBinder that writes an enum value to a bound property when a button is clicked, supporting set-by-value, set-by-index, and add-offset modes. UIValue_WriteEnum_Dropdown Represents a UIValueEnumBinder that drives a TMPro.TMP_Dropdown with localized enum options, writing the selected index back to the bound enum property. UIValue_WriteEnum_ToggleFlipFlop UIValueEnumBinder that uses a flip-flop toggle group to display and set a bound enum value. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.UI.Flight.html.title: Namespace KSP.UI.Flight | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.UI.Flight.html.summary: Namespace KSP.UI.Flight Classes ActionBar Represents the action bar HUD instrument in the flight UI, managing a set of ActionBarButton instances built from ActionBarButton_Data descriptors. AeroGUI Flight HUD panel that displays aerodynamic data including dynamic pressure, Mach number, angle of attack, and total lift, drag, and thrust forces. AppBar Represents the app bar displayed in the flight HUD, managing a set of AppBarButton instances keyed by app identifier. AppBarInstrument Represents the app bar HUD instrument in the flight UI, providing a popup canvas panel and binding game mode feature availability for science experiments and exploration missions. AtmosphericIndicatorInstrument Represents the atmospheric indicator instrument in the flight HUD. BurnTimerInstrument Represents a flight HUD instrument that displays a color-coded light tree for maneuver burn start and stop countdown and confirmation timing. FlagSiteUIManager Manages the in-flight flag-planting UI, handling site name and description input and coordinating input locks while the panel is visible. FlightControlInstrument A flight control HUD instrument that binds the view data provider context to its bind root during initialization. FlightHUDWorldLabelsInstrument Flight HUD instrument that pools and renders world-space labels for nearby vessels and waypoints. FlightHUDWorldLabelsInstrument.WorldLabel Represents a single world-space label bound to an IWorldLabelData source, managing its UI data bindings. FlightReportCrewItem Represents a single crew member entry in the flight report UI, displaying the crew icon and name. FlightReportLogItem Represents a single log entry in the flight report UI, displaying an icon and event text styled by the travel event's report style. FlightReportResearchItem Represents a single research item entry in the flight report UI, displaying an icon, title, and point value. FlightReportUIManager Manages the flight report UI panel displayed after a flight ends, aggregating sections for research, crew, logs, records, and mission status messages. FlightStagingStackInstrument Flight HUD instrument for the staging stack display, using FlightStagingUIDriver to manage staging UI and subscribing to delta-V and engine-mode change messages. FlightWidgetManager A base class for flight UI widget managers that depend on an IViewController backend and update when the active vessel changes. FunctionMenuInstrument A flight HUD instrument for the function menu, extending UIFlightHUDInstrument and binding the view data context on initialization. GameView Represents the root flight UI game view instrument, managing canvas visibility and mode transitions across flight, map, and tracking station views. GoButtonInstrument Flight HUD instrument for the go button, connecting a UIWidget_GoButton to the staging data provider. HACK_UIMouseover Hack MonoBehaviour that spawns a HACK_UIMouseoverInfo tooltip overlay on pointer enter and destroys it on pointer exit. HACK_UIMouseoverInfo Temporary workaround MonoBehaviour for displaying mouseover information text in the flight UI. IVAPortraits Represents the IVA crew portrait panel in the flight HUD, rendering and displaying portrait viewports for each seated Kerbal with EVA interaction and scrolling support. InteractInstrument Flight HUD instrument that displays available interaction prompts and their input key names for the active interact actions. KerbalCamera MonoBehaviour that temporarily overrides shadow cascade, anti-aliasing, and shadow distance quality settings during camera rendering and restores them immediately after each frame. NavballInstrument Represents the navball orientation indicator as a flight HUD instrument. NonStageableResourcesUI Flight HUD instrument for the non-stageable resources panel, binding the resource list element prefab to the resource data context. PhysicsForceDisplaySystem Represents the flight UI system that renders physics force vectors (drag, lift, and thrust) as color-coded overlays on active vessel parts. PhysicsForceDisplayVector Represents a physics force displayed as a debug arrow in the flight view. ThrottleInstrument Represents the throttle display instrument in the flight HUD. TimeWarpInstrument Represents the time warp level selector instrument in the flight HUD. TrackingStationToggleInstrument Represents a flight HUD instrument that toggles the tracking station, binding to the flight HUD context on initialization. UIDependendsOn<T> A base class for UI elements that hold a single backend dependency of type T and manage callback registration when that dependency is replaced. UIElement A base class for flight-scene UI elements with protected helpers for managing child GameObjects and instantiating prefabs. UIFlightHUDInstrument A base class for HUD instrument elements displayed in the flight UI, providing data binding and vessel or colony context classification. UIFlightHud Represents the root flight HUD panel, managing a collection of UIFlightHUDInstrument instances and controlling visibility in response to game state, vessel, and colony events. UIInfoLabel Represents a flight view info label combining an icon and text element with optional double-click support. UIWidget_GoButton Represents the flight HUD Go button widget, displaying staging information from StagingDataProvider and publishing GoButtonPressedMessage when pressed. VerticalSpeedInstrument Represents the vertical speed instrument in the flight HUD, displaying the vessel's vertical speed as a dial. VesselStatusInstrument Flight HUD instrument that displays vessel status information, binding the view data context on initialization. Distinguishes physics timewarp from regular timewarp: the banner becomes blue and shows "Phys Warp Active" when physics warp is engaged. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.VFX.html.title: Namespace KSP.VFX | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSP.VFX.html.summary: Namespace KSP.VFX Classes AfterBurnerVFXData Represents afterburner VFX data, mapping a normalized input value to a blend shape weight on a target SkinnedMeshRenderer. AggregationSet Represents a spatial node set backed by a SpatialBubbleDatabase configured for aggregate collision behavior. ContextualFxSystem Manages the contextual visual-effects system for vessels, coordinating reentry, contrail, and biome-based surface effects. FXCollisionContextualEvent Represents a contextual VFX event triggered by physics collisions. FXContextData Represents environmental and vessel context data supplied to visual effect systems. FXContextualEvent Abstract base class for a contextual VFX event, implementing ISpatialDatabaseNode. FXContextualEventParams Represents the contextual parameters for a VFX event, including the source transform, position, rotation, part behavior, explosion potential, and surface data. FXDecoupleContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for part decoupling, selecting between atmosphere and vacuum decouple prefabs based on the current situation. FXDetachmentContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for part detachment, extending FXContextualEvent. FXDockingContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for docking and undocking maneuvers, selecting atmosphere or vacuum effect prefabs based on the current situation. FXExplosionContextualEvent Contextual VFX event representing a part explosion, deriving from FXContextualEvent. FXFuelTankDecompressionIceContextualEvent Contextual VFX event that plays the fuel tank decompression ice effect on a part during launch. FXGroundBlastContextualEvent Represents a contextual VFX event for engine ground blast effects, driven by a Module_Engine and VesselBehavior. FXInstanceAggregator Aggregates FXContextualEvent instances into typed AggregationSet groups, partitioned by event type and fuel type for spatial deduplication of surface-impact and explosion VFX. FXKSCLaunchContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for KSC launch smoke and fire effects, driven by a vessel's thrust and distance from the launch position. FXKSCLaunchFireContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for the KSC launch fire effect, with event type LaunchFire. FXKSCLaunchSmokeContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for the KSC launch smoke effect, using the LaunchSmoke event type. FXKerbalFootstepContextualEvent Represents a contextual VFX event for kerbal footsteps, selecting a prefab name based on surface type and situation. FXKerbalPoofContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for the kerbal poof effect. FXParachuteDeployContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for parachute deployment, selecting between atmosphere and vacuum deploy prefabs based on the current flight situation. FXPersistantSurfaceContactContextualEvent Represents a contextual VFX event for persistent surface contact between a vessel part and a surface. FXReentryContextualEvent Contextual VFX event for atmospheric reentry, driving particle effects and light intensity on a vessel using velocity, altitude, and heat flux data. AssemblyCSharp/KSP.VolumeCloud.html.summary: Namespace KSP.VolumeCloud Classes BaseNoiseGenerator A base class for noise generators implementing the INoiseGenerator contract. BasicShape3dGenerator Generates a basic 3D cloud shape noise texture by sampling Perlin and Worley noise across four color channels. CloudLightManager Singleton manager that tracks lights and their shadow maps for the volumetric cloud rendering system. CloudLightManager.LightInfo Represents a light source and its associated shadow map tracked by CloudLightManager. CloudMaterialPass Named pass indices for the volumetric cloud material shader passes. CloudPropertyHash Cache of precomputed shader property IDs for the volume cloud rendering pipeline. CloudRenderHelper MonoBehaviour that manages volumetric cloud rendering for a celestial body, including quality level selection and directional light tracking. CloudRenderList Singleton registry that manages the active list of CloudRenderHelper instances and synchronizes VolumeCloudConfiguration settings to the scaled cloud rendering layer. CurlNoiseGenerator Generates curl noise texture samples by computing the curl of a 2D Perlin noise field via a PerlinNoiseGenerator. CustomTexGenerator Serializable INoiseGenerator implementation that blends Worley and Perlin octave noise at configurable weights and periods. FrameIndexSequences Tracks the temporal upscaling and spatio-temporal blue noise frame index sequences used in volume cloud rendering. MapTexture Manages a SparseTexture by dividing a source texture into tiles and loading or unloading individual tiles on demand based on a per-tile visibility check. NoiseTextureAdapter Adapter that wraps an INoiseGenerator to satisfy the ITextureGenerator interface, mapping noise samples to texture colors. PerlinNoiseGenerator Perlin noise implementation of BaseNoiseGenerator with configurable octave count for fractal noise output. Texture3dGenerator Generates multi-channel Worley noise texture data for volumetric cloud rendering, implementing ITextureGenerator and ITextureFastGenerator. Utils Utility methods for generating 3D and 2D textures from volume cloud texture generators. VolumeCloudBakeCubemap Camera image effect that bakes volumetric clouds to a cubemap. VolumeCloudConfiguration Represents a ScriptableObject asset that defines the volumetric cloud rendering configuration for a celestial body. VolumeCloudConfiguration.BoxCloudsGroup Represents a group of box clouds sharing a distribution texture, position, and a list of individual cloud box settings. VolumeCloudConfiguration.BoxCloudsGroupAutoGenerate Auto-generation parameters for a group of box clouds, specifying rotation angle, scale, position, and a list of cloud box settings. VolumeCloudConfiguration.BoxCloudsGroupFromTexture Represents the texture-derived placement data for a box cloud group, including UV coordinates, rotation, and scale. VolumeCloudConfiguration.BoxCloudsLayerData Cloud layer data for box-type clouds, extending VolumeCloudConfiguration.CloudsData with a list of individual VolumeCloudConfiguration.BoxCloudData instances. VolumeCloudConfiguration.CloudBoxSetting Configuration settings for a single cloud box, including transform, texture indices, and flow properties. VolumeCloudConfiguration.CloudsData Base data class for a volumetric cloud layer, containing common properties such as height range, wind, and movement settings. VolumeCloudConfiguration.CumulusData Cloud layer data for a cumulus cloud formation, extending VolumeCloudConfiguration.CloudsData with distribution maps, density, and detail texture settings. VolumeCloudRenderer Camera image-effect component that renders volumetric clouds via raymarching. VolumeCloudWindowConfigurations Configuration asset for the volume cloud editor window, holding generator references and texture save names. WorleyNoiseGenerator Noise generator that produces Worley (cellular) noise with configurable octaves, brightness, and contrast. Structs VolumeCloudConfiguration.BoxCloudData Represents the transform and rendering data for a single box cloud instance. VolumeCloudConfiguration.CloudsLayerStructuredBuffer Represents the structured buffer layout passed to the GPU shader for a volumetric cloud layer. Interfaces INoiseGenerator Interface for generating noise values at a given 3D position. ITextureFastGenerator Interface for fast texture generation, providing a method to sample all color values for 2D or 3D textures. ITextureGenerator Interface for sampling texture color values at a given 3D position. Enums CameraPositionOnCumulus The camera's vertical position relative to a cumulus cloud layer. CloudRenderHelper.QualitySelection Quality level options for volumetric cloud rendering. VolumeCloudConfiguration.CloudsLayerType The type of a volumetric cloud layer.

AssemblyCSharp/KSPPartAudioRTPCs.html.title: Namespace KSPPartAudioRTPCs | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/KSPPartAudioRTPCs.html.summary: Namespace KSPPartAudioRTPCs Classes KSPPartAudioRTPCBase A base class for KSP part audio RTPC entries that update real-time parameter control values on audio game objects. PartAngularVelocityRTPC RTPC entry that drives the k_angular_velocity audio parameter using the angular velocity magnitude of the owning part's rigidbody. PartAtmDensityRTPC Represents the atmospheric density RTPC for part audio, setting the audio parameter from the part's current atmospheric density. PartDragCoefficientRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC handler that drives the drag-coefficient runtime parameter using the part model's drag coefficient. PartDynamicPressureRTPC RTPC entry that updates the dynamic pressure real-time parameter control value on a part's audio game object. PartGForceRTPC Part audio RTPC entry that drives the g-force real-time parameter control value from the vessel's current g-force. PartJointTorqueRTPC Represents a KSPPartAudioRTPCBase implementation that drives the part stress audio parameter using the maximum joint torque of the owning part. PartMachNumberRTPC Part audio RTPC that reads the current vessel Mach number and applies it to the part audio system. PartMassRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC entry that drives the part mass real-time parameter control value from the part's physics mass. PartSpeedRTPC Represents a KSPPartAudioRTPCBase implementation that updates the part speed RTPC with the vessel's surface speed magnitude. PartStaticPressureRTPC RTPC entry that updates the static pressure real-time parameter control value on a part audio game object using the part's static pressure in kPa. PartTemperatureRTPC RTPC entry that drives the part temperature real-time parameter control from the vessel's external temperature. PartUnderWaterRTPC Represents a KSP part audio RTPC entry that controls the k_part_under_water parameter, setting it to 1 when the part model is submerged and 0 otherwise. PartVelocityMagnitudeRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC entry that updates the velocity magnitude parameter using the part's speed relative to the SOI body frame. TemperatureRatioRTPC RTPC entry that drives the part temperature ratio audio parameter from the heat indicator tracker's temperature ratio value. VesselAltitudeRTPC Represents a KSP part audio RTPC entry that drives the vessel altitude real-time parameter control value on part audio game objects. VesselAtmDensityRTPC Represents a KSPPartAudioRTPCBase that updates the vessel atmospheric density RTPC parameter on part audio game objects. VesselHeightFromGroundRTPC Represents a part audio RTPC entry that drives the vessel height-from-ground parameter using the active vessel's altitude above terrain. VesselStaticPressureRTPC KSP part audio RTPC entry that drives the vessel static pressure parameter with the vessel's current static pressure in kPa.

AssemblyCSharp/PatchManager.Core.Cache.C.title: Class ConfigReplay | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/PatchManager.Core.Cache.C.summary: Class ConfigReplay Tracks Config: bindings declared by Lua patches so they can be replayed on launches where the patch cache is hot and the scripts therefore do not re-run. Replay re-creates the bindings against the appropriate IConfigFile so the settings UI is populated, and compares the current value to the value the patch ran with to flag stale caches that need invalidating. Inheritance object ConfigReplay Namespace: PatchManager.Core.Cache Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public static class ConfigReplay Properties ChangedKeys Section/name pairs whose current value differs from the value the patch was last run with. Populated by ReplayAll(). Each entry is in the form {modId}:{section}/{name}. Declaration public static List<string> ChangedKeys { get; } Property Value Type Description List<string> HasStaleConfigs True if at least one tracked config value has changed since the last patch run, false otherwise. Callers treat this as a cue to invalidate the patch cache before applying patches. Declaration public static bool HasStaleConfigs { get; } Property Value Type Description bool StandaloneConfigs Config files for standalone single-file patches whose .lua file still exists on disk. SpaceWarp does not manage these (no descriptor), so the host is responsible for wiring them into the settings menu. Populated as standalone patches are resolved in GetConfigFileForMod(string, string) or replayed in ReplayAll(). Declaration public static IReadOnlyCollection<ConfigReplay.StandaloneConfigInfo> StandaloneConfigs { get; } Property Value Type Description IReadOnlyCollection<ConfigReplay.StandaloneConfigInfo> Methods GetConfigFileForMod(string, string) Resolves the config file a patch's bindings should live in. Descriptor mods reuse the SpaceWarp descriptor's ConfigFile so PatchManager bindings land in the same file as the rest of the mod's config; standalone single-file patches get a sidecar file alongside the .lua. Declaration public static IConfigFile GetConfigFileForMod(string modId, string standaloneLuaPath = null) Parameters Type Name Description string modId The mod ID. For standalone patches this is the patch filename stem. string standaloneLuaPath For standalone single-file patches, the absolute path to the .lua file. Null for descriptor mods. Returns Type Description IConfigFile The config file for the given patch. Exceptions Type Condition InvalidOperationException Thrown when standaloneLuaPath is null and no SpaceWarp descriptor is registered for modId. RecordEntry(string, string, string, string, string, string, object, object, IValueConstraint) Records (or overwrites) a binding into the inventory's replay slice for the given mod. Called from LuaPatchConfig as each Config: method runs. Declaration public static void RecordEntry(string modId, string standaloneLuaPath, string type, string section, string name, string description, object defaultValue, object ranWith, IValueConstraint constraint = null) Parameters Type Name Description string modId The mod ID the calling patch was loaded under. string standaloneLuaPath For standalone single-file patches, the absolute path to the .lua file. Null for descriptor mods. string type Type tag matching the Config: method that produced the entry. string section The config-file section the binding lives in. string name The binding's key within its section. string description Description string the patch declared. object defaultValue Default value the patch declared, serialized as JSON. object ranWith The current value at the time the patch ran, persisted so subsequent launches can detect changes. IValueConstraint constraint Optional constraint declared by the patch. ReplayAll() Replays every recorded binding against its mod's config file. Re-binds the entry so it shows up in the settings UI even on hot-cache launches, and flags ChangedKeys for any entry whose current value differs from the recorded ran-with. Declaration public static void ReplayAll() Remarks Should run early at startup, after SpaceWarp has populated PluginList but before deciding whether to use the patch cache. Slices for standalone patches whose .lua file no longer exists, or descriptor mods that are not loaded this run, are pruned from the inventory: the recorded ran-with no longer reflects reality. User-set values stay in the underlying .json config files and are re-bound automatically when the mod returns and its patches run again.

Inheritance object DelegateRegistry Namespace: PatchManager.LuaPatching.Utility Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public static class DelegateRegistry Remarks MoonSharp only ships built-in conversions for a fixed set of delegate types, so passing a Lua function to a method expecting Action<Foo> would otherwise throw at the boundary. By-ref, out, and pointer parameters are unsupported and the containing delegate type is skipped silently. AssemblyCSharp/Redux.CelestialBody.Redux.title: Class ReduxSurfaceSpawner | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/Redux.CelestialBody.Redux.summary: Class ReduxSurfaceSpawner Spawns an addressable prefab at a fixed lat/lon/altitude on the parent celestial body, gated by proximity to the active vessel. Inheritance object ReduxSurfaceSpawner Namespace: Redux.CelestialBody Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public class ReduxSurfaceSpawner : MonoBehaviour Remarks The spawn is backed by a standalone ECS entity parented to the body's celestialFrame entity in UniverseSimWorld. Systems.SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem computes the body-local TRS each frame from authored lat/lon/altitude in double precision, and Systems.SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem walks the reference-frame hierarchy down to physics space and writes the resulting world pose onto the spawned instance's Transform. All math happens in Vector3d / QuaternionD - only the final cast to Vector3 loses precision, and that cast happens near the floating origin where float precision is centimeter-scale. The addressable handle is released as soon as the prefab is instantiated. The instance is a runtime copy that survives the release. Subsequent spawn cycles re-load the addressable - the trade-off is more I/O on respawn for less memory held while no instance is active. AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Components.Surf.summary: Struct SurfaceAnchorData Per-anchor data for a surface-anchored entity managed by SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem. Namespace: Redux.Ecs.Components Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax public struct SurfaceAnchorData Remarks The authored block (Latitude / Longitude / Altitude / YawDegrees / AlignToSurfaceNormal) is mutable. ReduxSurfaceSpawner reads its public fields each frame and pushes any deltas into this component via a read-modify-write so the math job picks them up next tick. The baked block (SurfaceR / BodyRadius) is sampled from PQS once at spawn and never changes for the anchor's lifetime. SurfaceR is the total radial distance from the body center to the surface at the authored lat/lon (PQS.GetSurfaceHeight return value). AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Systems.Surface.title: Class SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem | KSP2Redux API (Develop)
AssemblyCSharp/Redux.Ecs.Systems.Surface.summary: Class SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem Pushes each surface-anchor entity's world pose onto its managed Unity Transform. Inheritance object ComponentSystemBase SystemBase SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem Namespace: Redux.Ecs.Systems Assembly: Assembly-CSharp.dll Syntax [UpdateInGroup(typeof(LateSimulationSystemGroup))] [UpdateAfter(typeof(SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem))] public class SurfaceAnchorUnityWriteSystem : SystemBase Remarks Runs after SurfaceAnchorTransformSystem in Unity.Entities.LateSimulationSystemGroup. Walks each anchor's frame hierarchy down into the active physics-space reference frame using the static helpers on Transformd, so all frame-conversion math stays in doubles. The only float cast happens on the final assignment to Transform, which sits near the floating origin where float precision is centimeter-scale. Suppresses transform writes whose delta from the previously-applied pose is below ~5 mm in position and ~0.01 degrees in rotation. This both avoids the Unity transform-dirty cost when nothing meaningful changed and prevents sub-millimeter precision noise from twitching the rendered pose. TransformNameAttribute Marks a string field as the bare leaf name of a single Transform within the part hierarchy. TransformPathAttribute Marks a string field that holds a slash-separated path to a Transform within the part hierarchy. UitkForKsp2/UitkForKsp2.MVVM.Bindings.Ev.summary: Class EventBinding Binds any UI Toolkit event on any VisualElement to an ICommand or ICommand<TEvent> on the data source. Works with every EventBase subclass - clicks, pointer, keyboard, focus, change, drag, navigation, and more. UXML usage: <!-- Parameterless: event fires command, data discarded --> <EventBinding property="name" data-source-path="HoverCommand" event-type="PointerEnterEvent" /> <!-- Typed: ViewModel receives full event object --> <EventBinding property="value" data-source-path="KeyDownCommand" event-type="KeyDownEvent" /> <!-- ChangeEvent special case: extracts newValue automatically --> <EventBinding property="value" data-source-path="VolumeCommand" event-type="ChangeEvent<System.Single>" /> The "property" attribute is required by the infrastructure but unused - set it to any valid property (e.g. "name"). Reflection runs only once per command instance - subsequent updates only sync enabled state.
